recipe.title: Creamy Roasted Garlic Tuscan White Bean Soup

ingredients.item: white kidney or cannellini beans, soaked overnight

prep.step: In a large pot over medium heat add olive oil and pancetta. Cook until fat is rendered from pancetta.

Add onion, celery and carrot, mix well to coat with oil mixture, cook until vegetables are soft, about 10 minuutes. Add red pepper flakes and stir for about 15 seconds, just enough to incorporate the flavour.

Pour in stock, add rosemary, bay leaf, beans and roasted garlic and bring to a boil. Turn down heat to a simmer and cook until the beans are soft and creamy. Cook time depend on how long the beans have been soaking, usually 45 to 50 minutes. Taste, and if needed, add salt and pepper.
Using a hand blender (or a blender) render the soup to the consistency you like. Serve with crusty bread.

ingredients.item: chicken broth, split 2 to pot, 2 for baked flour

prep.step: Bake flour. Allow to cool.
In a Dutch Oven over medium heat add oil. Once hot add onion, pepper and celery, saute until soft, 5 - 7 minutes.
Add garlic, bay leafs, thyme, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper. Stir to warm.
Add 2 cups chicken broth and chicken thighs. Simmer in pot until cooked through. Remove chicken from pot, set aside.
Temper flour: Place flour in large bowl. Warm remaining 2 cups of broth and slowly whisk flour into bowl. Once fully incorporated, pour into Dutch Oven.
Add andouille sausage, simmer in pot for about 20 minutes.
Using two forks, shred the cooked chicken add to pot. Remove bay leafs.
To finish gumbo, add spring onions, 1 tsp. white vinegar and pinch of salt. Serve over cooked rice.

notes.title: To Make Baked Flour
notes.content: Place flour in oven proof skillet. Set oven to 425F and cook in oven for about 45 minutes, until flour is colour of cinnamon or brown sugar.

ingredients.item: jicama, peeled and cut into thin strips (3 1/3 cups)
green, red or yellow sweet pepper, cut into thin strips
medium red onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings

prep.step: Combine cabbage, jicama, orange sections, pepper, red onion and cilianto/parsley in a large serving bowl. Cover and chill till serving time or up to 4 hours.
Combine peanut or salad oil, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce and dry mustard in screw-top jar. Cover and shake well. (Dressing can be made up to 1 week ahead and chilled, covered.)
To serve, toss the salad with dressing; sprinkle with peanuts.

ingredients.item: knob of ginger, sliced into thin match sticks

prep.step: Start by adding oil to a large skillet and heat it on medium. Add sugar and stir until sugar begins to melt. Keep stirring for a total of 2-3 minutes, the brown sugar will darken in colour. To avoid the sugar from burning stir constantly.

Add chicken thighs in a single layer, skin side down and let them sear for 2 minutes. Flip them over and then continue to let them cook for another 2 minutes. You really need to get some nice colour on them.
Add sliced onions, diced garlic and thinly sliced ginger. Toss to combine everything, about a minute.

Pour in coconut water/milk, fish sauce, sesame oil, salt and pepper. Cook, uncovered for 7-8 minutes or until the the sauce becomes thick and glossy. Give it a taste, adjust salt and pepper. To finish sprinkle on some scallons and serve with warm rice.

ingredients.name: Main Ingredients
ingredients.item: vegetable oil, or more, as needed
boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch chunks
Kosher salt and pepper to taste

prep.step: Sauce; whisk together mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, honey and Hot Sauce in a small bowl, set aside.
Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk, flour, cornstarch, egg, hot sauce, salt and pepper, to taste
Working one at a time, dip chicken into buttermilk mixture, then dredge in Panko, pressing to coat.
Working in batches, add chicken to the skillet and cook until evenly golden and crispy, about 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve immediately, drizzled with sweet chili sauce

ingredients.name: Burgers
ingredients.item: each kosher salt and black pepper
washed and dried Boston Lettuce leaves

prep.step: Preheat oven to 400F.

Lay ham slices in a single layer on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Place a second piece of parchment paper over ham and top with a second baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until ham is crisp. Let cool on a wire rack set over a plate.
In a medium bowl, sprinkle saffron over warm water. Let stand for 15 minutes. Stir in mayonnaise until well combined

Slit sausage skins and crumble sausage meat into a large bowl. Add ground pork, parsley, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper, and mix thoroughly until well combined. Form mixture into 4 even size patties about 1/2 inch thick. With the heel of your hand, make an indentation in centre of each patty.
Preheat barbecue to medium.

Cook patties on well oiled grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until a meat thermometer registers 170F. Just before burgers are ready, top each patty with one quarter of Manchego cheese. Split onion buns in half horizontally and toast, cut-side down, until golden.
Spread bottom halves of buns with saffron mayo. Top with Boston lettuce leaves. Add a burger to each bun, along with roasted red peppers and a slice of pancetta ham. Replace tops of buns.

ingredients.item: chicken broth, enough to cover the pasta
each, parmesan, smoked gouda, shredded white cheddar

prep.step: In a large pot bring stock to boil, add pasta. Cook to personal taste.
Drain, place pasta back in hot pot add cream and slowly stir in cheese.
Once cheese has melted add the tuffle oil and salt and pepper to taste.

notes.title: Cheese
notes.content: There is no hard rules about the cheese. Parmesan is always a good place to start, but use what you have just as long as it will melt evenly. Tip: place the cream and cheese on the counter and bring to room temperature. Makes it a lot easier to incorporate into the cooked pasta.

recipe.title: Sous Vide Flank Steak
recipe.ingredients:
flank/skirt steak, cut into 6 inch wide pieces.
soy sause
salt and pepper to taste
unsalted butter>

prep.step: Preheat sous vide water bath to 131F.
Season steak pieces evenly with the salt and pepper. Place in a gallon-size freezer-safe ziplock bag or vacuum bag. Arrange pieces in a single layer.
Lower bag(s) into water and cook for 8 hours.
Remove from bag(s) and let steak rest for 5 minutes. Transfer to plate and pat dry.

Heat butter in a large saute pan or skillet over medium-high heat, swirling it as it melts, until it has foamed and the foam has subsided, and then continue cooking until it turns light brown and smells nutty, about 2 minutes. Place the steaks in the brown butter and sear turning once, until golden brown on both sides, about 1 minute per side.
To serve, cut steak on the diagonal against the grain into 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.

ingredients.item: boneless/skinless chicken brests/thighs, cut into bite size pieces
fresh orange juice to make a cup
green onions and sesame seeds for garnish

prep.step: Put oil in pot, set to saute and add chicken in batches.
Cook, stirring often until lightly browned, remove and set aside.
When it's all done, put all the chicken back in add garlic and ginger, cook for about a minute.
Add ketchup, brown sugar, orange juice and zest, sesame oil ,soy sauce, hot sauce and rice vinegar.
Stir well to mix, seal instant pot, select high pressure and cook for 5 minutes. Quick release the steam.
Remove the lid, set to saute, mix cornstach with water and add to pot.
Let it bubble away until thickened to where you want it.
Serve on rice or rice noodles with green onion and sesame seeds.

ingredients.item: can chopped San Marzano style tomatoes
beef stock paste or bouillon cube

prep.step: Turn instant pot to saute
Season ribs with Kosher salt and pepper, add oil to the pot and when hot sear the ribs in batches until brown on all sides - remove and set aside.
Add the corrots, celery, onion and garlic - saute until softened.
Add tomato paste, mix well and let cook a few minutes, then stir in wine, scraping along the bottom as you go to release anything stuck on.
Add tomatoes, beef stock, red pepper flacks, oregano and salt and pepper.
Stir well to combine then put back in ribs.
Lock, turn instant pot to sealing position, select high pressure and cook for 45 minutes.
When done, let the steam release naturally.
Remove ribs, turn pot to saute and let the liquid to thicken.
Shred the beef and return to pot to thickened.
Check salt and pepper, adjust to your liking. Serve on pasta.

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold or small White potatoes

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F.
If using Yukon Golds, peel the potaotes. Cut potaotes into even size. Cover with cold water salted water and parboil for 7 - 8 minutes, drain into colander and leave to steam dry for 3 minutes.
Give the colander a good shake to help chuff up the potatoes, help to make them crisp later on.
Tip into a large tray in one layer, add butter, olive oil, season well with salt and pepper.

Toss the potatoes in the butter and olive oil and roast for 30 minutes or until lightly golden brown and three quarters cook. Remove from oven and gently squash each potato with a potato masher to increase its' surface area. More of the potatoes that's in contact with the pan, the crisper they will be.
In a small bowl add a good lug of oil, strip the rosemary. Break up the garlic bulb (use as much as you like), and add the unpeeled cloves to the bowl along with a good splash of red wind vinegar.
Add contents to potatoes and return to the oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until crispy, bubbly and delicious.

recipe.title: Vanilla and Cocoa Biscuits For Linzer Cookies

prep.step: Combine all ingredients, do not overmix.
Flatten into a disk on plastic wrap.
Refridgerate for 1 hour. Roll into 1/4 inch sheet. Use a cookie cutter cut out biscuits
Bake at 325F for 12 minutes. Cool.
Eat individually as a biscuit of use 2 biscuits and sandwich jam (sue jam only before serving, jam tends to soften biscuit.

notes.title: Substitution
notes.content: Dr Octker not avaiable substitute vanilla and add 50g sugar.

ingredients.item: freshly ground black pepper to taste
freshly grated Parmesan cheese, at room temperature

prep.step: In a saucepan, warm broth over low heat.
Warm 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in mushrooms and cook until soft. Remove mushrooms and their liquid and set aside.

Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to skillet and stir in shallots. Cook 1 minute. Add rice, stirring to coat with oil, about two minutes. When the rice has taken on a pale, golden colour, pour in wine, stirring constantly until the wine is fully absorbed. Add 1/2 cup broth to the rice and stir until the broth is absorbed. Continue adding broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring continuously, until liquid is absorbed and the rice is al dente, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in mushrooms with their liquid, butter, chives and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Preheat oven 350F.
In a large mixing bowl, cream the eggs with sugar until smooth and pale.
Add orange zest, all orange juice and soften butter. Mix well.
Sift in flour and baking powder (mix the two beforehand) and mix well. Pour the batter into a loaf tin (10 x 4 inch) lined with baking paper.
Bake for 55 minutes or until an inserted skewer comes out clean.
When ready, take out from oven pour gazing over loaf. Let it sit for about 10 minutes before transfering to a wired rack. Let cool completely.
Sauce: Melt butter add onion and garlic cook over low heat until onions softened.
Add flour and cook 1 - 2 minutes.
Combine milk and broth. Add a small amount at a time to thicken. Continue adding until all liquid incorported.
Add salt, pepper and Italian spices.
Assembly: Preheat oven to 350F.Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Layer potatoes over lapping using 1/4 to 1/3 of potatoes.
Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle on parmaesan cheese.
Spoon layer with sauce.
Repeat with remaining potatoes, creating 3 or 4 layers.
When completed pour remaining sauce over last layer.
Cover baking dish with foil wrap.
Bake 45 minutes, uncover and bake additional 40 - 45 minutes. Place under broiler for remaining 3 - 4 minutes to make top golden.
Rest for 15 minutes before serving

notes.title: Tomato Potato au gratin
notes.content: Add 1 - 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese to sauce prior to layers.

ingredients.item: raisins, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes

prep.step: MIX AND AUTOLYSE: In a large bowl combine all the ingredients, starter, flour, water, soaked raisins, salt and maple syrup. Use a dough whisk, spatula or hands to combine the ingredients. Turn it out on a lightly-floured surface and knead or use a bench scraper to smooth the dough as much as possible using a kneading motion (using your hands) or by scooping the dough from the bottom and folding it over itself (using a bench scraper). Lightly oil the surface of another bowl and return the dough to the bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit for one hour (autolyse).

STRETCH AND FOLD: After the hour autolyse, wet one of your hands (helps to prevent sticking), take one piece of the dough, stretch until the point of resistance then fold it over itself. Repeat this three to four times. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap again and wait 30 minutes for the next stretch and fold. Stretch and fold three times every thirty minutes over the course of 1 1/2 hours. With each stretch and fold you notice gluten development in the dough.

BULK FERMENTATION: After the stretch and fold session allow the dough to continue to proof until it's ready for shaping. In a warmer kitchen (about 24C/75F) the remaining proof time after stretch and fold will be roughtly one to two hours (with healthy, robust starter). One way to check for readiness is the finger-dent test. Dip your finger in flour and poke the dough; if the dough is slow to spring back or doesn't spring back completely, it's ready for shaping.[A cooler kitchen (in the mid 15C/60F to low 21C/70F) will require a little longer to proof. If you start this process in early evening and you have a cool kitchen you can leave your dough overnight. You can also store it in the refrigerator overnight to slow the fermentation and continue with shaping in the morning.]

SHAPING AND FINAL PROOF: After bulk fermentation carefully turn the dough out on a lightly-floured surface. As you coax the dough out of the bowl the top surface will become the bottom once it's turned out on the surface. You'll want to de-gas the dough a little and stretch it to a rectangle shape but rather than using a rolling pin take two edges of the dough and gently pull them apart without tearing the gluten strands. Pull taking two edges at a time until you have roughly a rectangle shape or large square. Sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar mixture over the entire top surface of the dough. Next, fold the wide part of the dough in thirds by taking one side and folding it two thirds of the way over then taking the other side and folding it ove the already-folded side. Then roll the dough starting with one of the ends until you have a log. Pinch the seams. Spray a loaf pan with cooking spray or rub with oil and transfer the rolled dogh seam side down. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to proof for one more hour. You should see a visible rise to the dough during the time.

BAKE: Preheat you oven to 425F. Make on slash along the length of the dough, (off the side a little) then put it in the oven. Bake for 10 minutes the reduce the temperature 400F. Bake for another 30-40 minutes or until the loaf is golden brown or the loaf registers 180F in the centre. Transfer to a wire rack and cool then enjoy as is or toasted.

ingredients.name: For the Meat Loaf
ingredients.item: good Ham diced into 1/4 inch cubes

prep.step: Preheat oven to 400F.
In a saute pan, heat the oil add the onions and cook until lightly brown, remove from heat and let cool to room temperature while you prepare the rest of the recipe.

In a large bowl, mix the ground meats, add the ham, salami, carrots, fresh herbs, eggs, garlic, bread crumps, Worcestershire Sauce, salt and pepper, buttermilk, hot sauce (if using) and cooled onions, mix well.

Cover the bottom of a bread loaf pan sideways with bacon slices, slightly overlapping each slice. Cover the ends of the bread pan with bacon, leaving enough to pull back over the top to completely cover the meatloaf mixture. Pack meat mixture into the pan. Take the ends of the bacon from the side and pull them over the meat mixture, cover completely using the long bacon from the ends. Carefully, flip the entire loaf onto a baking sheet, remove the bread pan and bake, in the middle of the oven for about 60 minutes.
Place all the ingredients for the glaze in a glass bowl, using a whisk, blend well. Using a brush, generously brush the glaze on top.
Check the internal temperature after 60 minutes. You looking for a temperature near to 145F to 150F, which is medium and slightly pink.

notes.title: Things to consider:
notes.content: Watch the salt, the bacon and processed meats should be enough.
Once you pack the breadpan you'll have lots left over, don't worry you can freeze the excess for a couple of months.

Once the meatloaf reaches 140F, take it out of the oven. It will keep cooking for a while and reach 145F, medium rare. If you want it cooked more then keep it in the oven but it goes from juicy to overcooked very quickly.

prep.step: Bring all the ingredients, except for the orange liqueur, to a simmer in a large, heavy-bottemed pot, stirring often. Simmer for about 15 minutes, or until pears are tender and cranberries have popped. Stir in the orange liqueur.
Pack into sterilized jars and seal, or store refrigerated for up to 4 weeks. Can be frozen for up to 3 months.
Cut the green part and root off of the leak, leaving just the white part. Cut in half lengthwise, then rinse well to clean out any dirt and grit. Slice thinly and set aside
In a large, deep skillet or Dutch Oven, cook the bacon over medium heat, stirring, until almost crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain, leaving a few teaspoons of bacon grease behind.
Add the butter to the pan. Add the leeks and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 4 - 5 minutes. Add cabbage and broth or water.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the bacon, toss, cover, and continue cooking for 5 - 10 minutes longer, until cabbage is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve drizzled with cider vinegar or pass the vinegar at the table.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting

prep.step: Preheat oven to 325F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper; set aside. Whisk together flour, cocoa, spices, salt, baking powder and baking soda.

Cream butter and brown sugar on medium speed in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment until pale and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add egg, molasses and grated ginger; mix until combined. Add flour mixture; mix on low speed until just combined.

Halve dough; flatten into two disks. Wrap in plastic wrap; refrigerate 1 hour. Transfer disks, one at a time, to a lightly floured surface; roll out to 1/4 inch thick. Use 3-inch acorn or leaf cookie cutters to make shapes; place 1 inch apart on sheets. Refridgerate until firm, about 20 minutes.
Score designs with a knife; sprinkle with sanding sugar. Bake, rotating sheets halfway through, until cookies are firm, 11 to 13 minutes. Let cool on a wire rack.

About an hour before cooking, remove the duck breasts from the refrigerator. Use a sharp knife to score the skin: Make 3 to 4 parallel shallow cuts into the skin, but not through it, in one direction, then make 3 to 4 shallow cuts in the another direction, making a cross hatch or diamond pattern. Pat the duck breasts dry with paper towels.
Season the breasts on all sides with salt (you might not use all the salt; that's fine). Set aside and let rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the potato into small 1/2 inch cubes.
Place the duck breasts skin-side down in a large cast iron skillet and turn the heat to medium. You want to crisp the skin slowly, driving out as much of the fat as possible.
After 6 to 8 minutes, the pan will have filled with a substantial amount of fat from the skin. The skin should be a very dark golden-brown.

Flip the breasts and cook for 3 to 4 minutes more. Add the potatoes to the pan right after you flip the breasts. Cook until the breasts are plump and register 135F in the thickest part of the breasts for medium-rare.

Remove the duck breasts to a clean plate or cutting board and let rest 5 minutes. Continue cooking the potatoes, stirring regularly, until they are golden-brown on the outside and tender inside, 5 to 7 minutes.
Slice the duck breasts on the diagonal and serve over the potatoes with any accumulated juices on the rest plate.

ingredients.name: Batter
ingredients.item: unsalted butter, plus more for the pan

prep.step: Preheat oven to 325F. Butter a 9-inch springform pan (or 8" baking pan), and set aside.
Make batter: Put butter and chocolate in a heatproof medium bowl set over a pan of simmering water; stir until melted. Let cool slightly.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl; set aside.

Put sugar and eggs in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, and beat on medium speed until pale and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add chocolate mixture, milk and vanilla and beat until combined. Add flour mixture; beat, scraping down sides of bowl, until well incorporated.
Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake until a cake tester inserted into brownies (avoid centre and edges) comes out with a few crumbs but is not wet, 27 to 30 minutes. Let cool completely in pan.

Make topping when brownies are cool: Put chocolate in a medium bowl. Heat cream in a small saucepan over medium-high heat until just simmering. Pour over chocolate; let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir until smooth. Allow ganache to cool, stirring every 10 minutes, until slightly thickened, 25 to 30 minutes.

Pour ganache over cooled brownies in pan; let set, about 20 minutes. Refrigerate until cold, 30 minutes to 1 hour. Let brownies stand at room temperature at least 15 minutes before serving. Lift out brownies; cut into wedges, wiping knife with a hot, damp cloth between each cut.

ingredients.item: potatoes, sliced (sweet or white or combo)

prep.step: Preheat the oven to 300F. Salt and pepper the chicken pieces. In an oven-safe pan, heat the oil and sear the thighs skins side down on medium heat until browned. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Check the amount of oil in pan, add some butter if needed to bring it up to around 3 tablespoons. On medium heat, mix the flour into the oil and cook stirring until starting to brown.
Gradually whisk in the chicken stock and then tomato paste.
Add the garlic, thyme, potatoes, carrots and onions. Nestle the chicken on top, cover and move to oven.
Cook for 45 minutes to an hour, until chicken is cooked through.
Remove from oven, and sprinkle on the peas and corn; recover and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients.name: Vinaigrette
ingredients.item: loosely packed fresh Italian Parsley leaves
dried oregano or smail bunch fresh

ingredients.name: Salad
ingredients.item: head romaine lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces
Ricotta salata or Feta cheese to taste

prep.step: Make the dressing: Combine all dressing ingredients in a food processor and blitz to blend.

Place all of the salad ingredients except for the cheese in a large bowl. Right before serving, add about half of the dressing and toss. Add more dressing little by little as necessary; be sure to dress greens very generously, otherwise salad will be bland. Toss in the chesse, then taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

notes.title: The Ricotta Cheese
notes.content: Salata is an Italian sheep's milk cheese that has a salty, sligthly tangy flavour, almost like a dry Italian feta. It is not the same as the wet ricotta in the tub. You can find it at Whole Foods, or gourmet grocers or specialty cheese shops.

ingredients.item: a pinch of kosher salt, more or less to taste

prep.step: Heat olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium-low heat. Add in diced onion, a pinch of kosher salt and saute until soft and translucent. About 5 to 8 minutes.
Add in the dried oregano, basil, tomato paste and minced garlic. Cook for 2 minutes to caramelize and cook the garlic before pouring in the white wine. Simmer for 2 to 4 minutes until reduced.
Add in the crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and 1/2 a can (about 3/4 cup) water. Stir and simmer, uncovered for 12 to 15 minutes. Taste and season with 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste.

notes.title: Add Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
notes.content: Great way to use cherry tomatoes at the "end" of their shelf life.

prep.step: Preheat oven to 400F. Grease muffin cups or line with muffin liners

Combine 1 1/2 cups flour, 3/4 sugar, salt and baking powder. Place oil into a 1 cup measuring cup; add the egg and add enough milk to reach the 1-cup mark. Mix this with flour mixture. Fold in blueberries. Fill muffin cups right to the top, and sprinkle with crumb mixture. Each muffin should hold 3oz of batter.
To Make Crumb Topping: Mix together 1/2 cup sugar, 1/3 cup flour, 1/4 cup butter and 1 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Mix with fork, and sprinkle over muffin before baking.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven or until done.
This recipe makes 9 large muffins.
Preheat oven to 450F.

The secret to excellent biscuits is COLD BUTTER. Really cold. Many times the biscuit dough gets worked so much that the butter softens before the biscuit even go in the oven. Try cutting the butter into small pieces and stick back in the fridge pulling out only when ready to incorporate into the dough.
Combine the dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Use a pastry cutter to cut cold butter into flour mixture. Don't go too crazy here - you want to see small, pea-sized pieces of butter throughout the dough.
Add in the milk and egg and mix just until the ingredients are combined. The dough will be sticky but don't keep working it. You should be able to see the butter pieces in the dough.
Turn the dough out onto a generously floured surface. Sprinkle some flour on to the top of dough so it won't stick to your fingers and knead 10-15 times. If the dough is super sticky add flour.
Pat the dough out to 3/4 - 1 inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter or glass.
Place the biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet or parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown on top.
For extra yumminess, brush the tops of the biscuits with melted salted butter.
Whisk together sugar, flour and salt.
Put buttermilk and yolks in a small saucepan.
Gradually whisk sugar mixture into saucepan and cook over medium heat. Whisk constantly until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon (about 4 to 5 minutes). Stir in vanilla, zest and lemon juice.
Pour cream into a bowl set in an ice bath. Let cool completely, stirring occasionally.
Refridgerate in an airtight container until ready to use; up to 2 days.
To serve; whip cream to soft peaks. Gently fold into pastry cream. Pastry cream makes 12 tarts or one large 9x9 tart. Refridgerate 1 hour, top with any type of berries for a summer treat.
For (French 75) add 2 oz Sparkling wine or Champagne for (Bees Knees) add 2 oz. Sparkling water.
Mix well, enjoy!

notes.title: Simply Honey recipe
notes.content: Add Honey and water in equal amounts in small bowl, heat to combine, do not boil.
Preferred Gin has floral overtones like Hendrick's Mid Summer Solstice.

ingredients.item: red bell peppers, seeded and chopped
canned diced or 10 fresh roma tomatoes

prep.step: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Saute the onion, bell pepper, jalapeno, mushrooms, tomatoes and corn for 10 minutes or until the onions are translucent. Season with black pepper, cumin and chili powder. Stir in the black beans, stock and salt. Bring to boil
Reduce heat to medium low. Remove 1/2 cups of the soup to food processor or blender; puree and stir the bean mixture back into the soup. Serve hot by itself or over rice.

recipe.title: Thick and Hardy Pinto Bean Chili

ingredients.item: cooked pinto beans (or 2 cans, rinsed and drained)
cayenne or other red pepper to taste

prep.step: Remove and discard the stems from the chiles. Place them in a small saucepan and pour the water over them. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Allow to cool. Put the chiles and the water into a blender and puree until well-blended. Pour into a strainer, pressing lightly on the pulp to get out all the flavour. Throw the pulp away and reserve the liquid.

In a large non-stick, saute the onion in a little water (1 tablespoon to start) until it's beginning to brown. Add the garlic, bell pepper and a little more water and saute for 3 more minutes. Add the reserved chile sauce, tomatoes, tomato sauce, beans, cumin, oregano, black pepper and paprika and bring to a simmer.

In a small bowl, mix the cocoa powder with 1/4 cup hot water until it is well blended. Add it to the chili. Taste for seasonings and add salt nad red pepper to taste. If it seems bitter add sugar. Cook on low for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavours to blend.

notes.content: If you can't find dried chiles, try substituting 1 cup of vegetable broth plus a tablespoon or so of chili powder. Increase the chili powder to taste Proceed to step 2.

prep.step: Garnish with a twist of orange rind.
Preheat oven to 400F. On top of stove, saute fillings until soft.
If making homemade pie crust (Pastry Recipe) and using dijon, add to pastry recipe. Roll out pastry.
Fill pastry with saute fillings. Add salt and pepper and cover with cheese.
Pour egg over fillings.
Place in oven and cook for 10, then reduce heat to 375F for 30 minutes or until the eggs set.

notes.title: Fillings
notes.content: Add chopped onion, mushroom, red pepper, ham or bacon or anything you like

prep.step: Whisk flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together in a large bowl. Grate the frozen butter using a grater. Add it to the flour mixture and combine with a pastry cutter, two forks or your fingers until the mixture comes together in pea-size crumbs. Mix bacon and cheeddar into flour mixture. Place in the fridge or freezer as you mix the wet ingredients together.
Whisk cream and egg together in a bowl. Drizzle over the flour mixture and mix together until everything appears moist.
Pour onto counter and, with floured hands, work dough into a ball as best you can. Press into a 8-inch disc and with sharp knife cut into 8 wedges.
Brush scones with cream.
Place scones on a plate or lined baking sheet and refridgerator for at least 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400F.
Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, arrange scones 2-3 inches apart on the baking sheet.

Bake for 18-26 minutes or until golden brown around the edges and lightly browned on top. Remove and cool for a few minutes. Leftover scones keep well at room temperature for 2 days or in the refridgerator for 5 days.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour combined with 1 tsp. salt
oil for cooking, with a high smoke point

prep.step: Place the meat between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound them until 1/4 inch thick. Lightly season both sides with salt and pepper.

Place the flour mixture, egg and crumbs in 3 separate shallow bowls. Dip the meat in the flour, the egg and crumbs, coating both sides and all edges at each stage. Be careful not to press the crumbs into the meat. Gently shake off the excess crumbs. Don't let the schnitzel sit in the coating or they will not be as cripsy once fried (fry immediately).

Make sure the cooking oil is hot enough at this point (about 350F) as you don't want the schnitzel to sit around in the coating before frying. You will need to bring back the temperature between batches.
Fry the schnitzel for aboutbea;2-3 minutes on both sides until a deep golden brown. Transfer briefly to a plate lined with paper towels.
Serve immediately with slices of fresh lemon and parsley or with your choice of sauces. Serve with French Fries, potato salad or fresh green salad.

notes.title: Consider
notes.content: Rather than a sauce, make a mushroom/beef gravy to pour over top, whick makes a dish call Jagerschnitzel.

prep.step: Tip the mussels into a large bowl of cold water, rinse and then drain well and pull away any 'beards'.
Place the chopped onion, shallot and garlic in a saucepan, with the olive oil,gently sweat them over a low to medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until slightly soft.
Add the chopped herbs and pernod/pastis, if using, and mix with the onion mixture.

Add the washed mussels to the pan and cover with dry wine, bring slowly to the boil, the simmer gently whilst stirring. Continue until the mussels have opened - discard any that do not open, this can take between 2 to 5 minutes.
Add the creme fresh, if using, mixing through the cooked and opened mussels. Cover until fries are cooked.
Serve the mussels in a deep bowl with the fries on the side. Provide plenty of napkins and large bowl for shells.

notes.title: Options or Substitutes
notes.content: For a milder favour, use leeks in lieu of onions.

recipe.title: Slow Cook Balsamic Beef Pot Roast

prep.step: Sprinkle the roast with salt and pepper. Preheat a large pan on the stove top over medium high heat. When the pan is hot add the oil. Brown the roast on both sides and then add to the slow cooker.
Add the oregano, basil, garlic, Italian Dressing, onion and balsamic vinegar.
Cover and cook on LOW for 9-10 hours without openning the lid during cooking time.
Shred and enjoy with your favourite sides.

ingredients.item: bunch of watercress, coarse stems discared
ripe avocados, seed removed, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces
skinless boneless chicken breast, halved, cooked and diced
tomato, seeded and chopped fine or halved cherry tomatoes
hard-boiled eggs, separated, the yolk and white finely chopped

prep.step: Cook the bacon in a skillet on medium heat until crisp on both sides. Remove from skillet and lay out on paper towel to absorb the excess fat. Allow bacon to cool. Crumble the bacon and set aside.
Toss the various lettuces: In a large salad bowl, toss together well the various lettuces and watercress.
Compose the salad: Arrange the cooked chicken, bacon, tomatoe(s), and the avocado decoratively over the greens and garnish the salad with the chopped egg and chives.
Make the Vinaigrette: In a small bowl whisk together the vinegar, mustard and salt to pepper to taste. Add the oil in a slow stream, whisking the dressing until emulsified.
Stir in the Roquefort. Add sugar ot taste, 1/2 teaspoon at a time. Whisk the dressing. Serve separately or toss in with the salad.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: All lettuces should be rinsed, spun or patted dry, and coarsely chopped - or choose to use only one type of lettuce.
Cheese can be incorporated into dressing as stated above or simply cut into salad which is Mike's preference.

prep.step: Combine, wait approximately 4 minutes, enjoy!
Set a pan on the stove top and set to medium-high heat. Add the cooking oil and brown the chicken on both sides.
Add the diced potatoes and green beans to the bottom of the slow cooker, toss to combine.

Add chicken thighs on top of potatoes and green beans. Add the garlic. Drizzle the tomato sauce, then sprinkle over the salt, pepper, thyme and rosemary. Take a spatula and smear around the sauce trying to combine the seasoning into the sauce.
Cover and cook on High for 4.5 hours. Do not open the lid during the cooking time or the potatoes will not get tender.

notes.title: Options
notes.content: Replace the green beans with assorted diced mushrooms. Try different spice combinations; add heat or texture to the dish.

ingredients.item: can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

prep.step: Add olive oil to a large soup pot and place it over medium-high heat for two minutes. Add the onion. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground beef to the pot. Break it apart with a wooden spoon. Cook for 6 - 7 minutes, until the beef is browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the chili powder, cumin, sugar, tomato paste, garlic powder, salt, pepper and optional cayenne pepper. Stir until well combined.
Add the broth, diced tomatoes (with their juice), kidney beans and tomato sauce. Stir to combine.

Bring the liquid to a low boil. Then reduce the heat (low to medium-low) to gently simmer the chili, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring occasionaly. For a thicker chili, simmer for 1 1/2 hours, watch the liquid level and adjust with more broth if required.
Remove the pot from the heat. Let the chili rest for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.
Pour 1 1/2 cups warm water (100 - 110F) into a large bowl; sprinkle with yeast and let stand until foamy, between 5 and 15 minutes.

Whisk sugar, oil and salt into yeast mixture. Add flour and stir until a sticky dough forms. You may need to adjust the amount of water. Transfer dough to an oiled bowl and brush top with oil. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm, draft-free place until dough has doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead 1 or 2 times before using.

Dough can be stored in an oiled bowl, covered with plastic, in refrigrator up to 2 hours. To freeze, wrap dough in plastic and freeze in a resealable freezer bag up to 3 months. If you plan to use it in a recipe that calls for half a batch, divide it before freezing.

notes.title: Our favourite toppings.
notes.content: Black and green sliced Olives. Thinly sliced red onion with sliced medium and hot salami.

ingredients.item: butter or olive oil, plus more if needed
mixed mushrooms, cut into 1 inch chunks
kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper
leek, or 2 small, white and light green parts, diced
tamari or soy sauce, or to taste
fresh thyme branches or 1/2 tsp. dried
chanterelle or oyster mushrooms, thinly sliced
Polenta, egg noodles or mashed potatoes, for serving
Chopped flat leaf parsley, for serving

prep.step: Add 2 tablespoons butter or oil to large Dutch oven or pot and set it over medium heat. When the fat is hot, stir in half the mushrooms and half the pearl onions. (If it doesn't all fit in the pot in one layer, you might have to do this in three batches, rather than two). Without moving them around too much, cook the mushrooms until they are brown on one side. Stir and let them brown on the other. Use a slotted spoon to transfer mushrooms and onions to a large bowl or plate and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Repeat with remaining mushrooms and pearl onions, seasoning as you go.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Add another tablespoon butter or oil to pan. Add leeks and carrots and saute until the leeks turn lightly golden and start to soften. Add the 2 minced garlics and saute for about 1 minute. Stir in tomato paste and cook for another 1 minute. Stir in flour and cook for about 1 minute, then add wine, broth, tamari or soy sauce, thyme and bay leaf, scraping up the brown bits at the bottom.

Add reserved mushrooms and pearl onions back to the pot and bring to a simmer. Partly cover and simmer on low heat until carrots and onions are tender and sauce is thick, 30 to 40 minutes. Taste and add more salt and pepper and tamari/soya sauce as needed. Stir in grated garlic.

Just before serving, heat a small skillet over high heat and add 1/2 tablespoon butter. Add half of sliced chanterelles or oyster mushrooms and let cook without moving until they are crisp and brown on one side. Flip and cook on the other side. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with salt and smoked paprika. Repeat with remaining butter and mushrooms. Serve mushroom Bourguignon over polenta, egg noodles or potatoes, topped with fired mushrooms and parsley.

notes.title: Vegetarian Cooking
notes.content: Patient is key. Browning the mushrooms and pearl onions builds flavour. Instead of preparing the mushrooms and pearl onions in a Dutch oven, use a large skillet over medium high heat to ensure that the mushrooms and onions are completely browned. Patient leads to deep flavour.

prep.step: Autolyse: Add measured flour in a large bowl. Add measured water (90 - 95F / 30 - 32C) and mix until incorporated. Cover and let rest for at least 30 minutes.
Add Starter & Salt: Add measured starter and salt to dough. Mix together. Fold ingredients until completely integrated. Rest for about an hour

Folding the dough: Keep a container of warm water at hand, dip your hands into water then stretch and fold the dough. Turn the bowl 1/4 turn, grab, stretch the dough over itself. Do this step at least 4 times. This will build the gluten in the bread. Repeat this step every 1/2 hour in the first 2 1/2 hours. Allow to rest for another 2 to 4 hours. Try and maintain a dough temperature of between 65 - 72F (18 - 22C).
Divide: With floured hands, ease the dough onto a lightly flour surface. Flour the surface with flour and cut the dough in half.
Shape: Dust proofing basket with flour. Shape each piece of dough in to medium-tight ball. Place each seam down in its proofing basket.

Preheat & Baking: At least 45 minutes prior to baking, put 2 Dutch ovens, with lids on, in a preheated 450F oven. Invert the proofed loaf from its basket onto a piece of parchment paper large enough to fit inside the Dutch oven. Place seam side up, cover and bake for 30 minutes, then uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from Dutch oven and tilt onto a rack. Let loaf rest for at least 20 minutes before slicing.

notes.title: Bakers Percentages Example- Based on Weight of Bread Flour
notes.content: Flour = 800g
Water 80% = 640g
Starter 15% = 120g
Salt 2% = 16g

ingredients.item: your choice, all-purpose, bread, whole wheat, flour
sugar, follow instruction on yeast jar

prep.step: Pour yeast and sugar in to warm water. Wait until yeast activated.
Add water/yeast and salt to flour. Mix until all water absorbed by flour.

Once combined, pour dough on lightly floured surface and kneed for at least 10 minutes. Flour will become more elastic as gluten builds within the dough. Cover in lightly oiled bowl. Let proof in warm spot for at least 2 hours; should double in size.
Pour raised dough onto lightly floured surface, punch down dough cut into two loafs and place bread pans.Cover the pans with a damp cloth and allow to proof for another hour.
While dough is proofing, preheat oven to 400F. Cook for 30 - 35 minutes.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour, plus extra for maintaining starter

prep.step: Combine whole wheat and all-purpose flour in a large container. Using wooden spoon, mix 1 cup flour mixture and 2/3 cup room-temperture water in a glass bowl until no dry flour remains. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature until bubbly and fragrant, 48 to 72 hours. Reserve remaining flour mixture.

FEED STARTER: Measure out 60mL starter and transfer to clean bowl or jar; discard remaining starter. Stir in 75mL flour mixture and 60mL room temperature water into starter, combine until no dry flour remains. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 24 hours.

Repeat step 2 every 24 hours until starter is pleasently aromatic and doubles in size 8 to 12 hours after being fed, about 10 to 14 days. At this point starter is mature and ready to be baked with, or it can be moved to storage. (If baking, user starter once it has doubled in size during 8-to-12 hour window. Use starter within 1 hour after it starts to deflate once it reaching it peak

notes.title: To Store and Maintain Mature Starter
notes.content: Measure out 60mL starter and transfer to clean jar; discard remaining starter. Stir 74mL all-purpose or bread flour and 60mL room-temperature water into starter and combine until no dry four remains. Loosely covered and let sit at room temperature for 5 hours. Cover and transfer to refrigerator. If not baking regularly, repeat process weekly.

Eighteen to 24 hours before baking, measure out 120mL starter and transfer to clean bowl; discard remaing starter. Stir in 150mL all-purpose flour and 120mL room temperature water into the starter. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 5 hours. Measure out amount of starter call for in bread recipe and transfer to a second bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours or up to 18 hours. Remaining starter should be refrigerated and maintained as directed.

ingredients.item: milk of choice: almond, cows, etc

prep.step: In a large saucepan, combine the water and milk. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat. In the meantime, melt the butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Once simmering, add the oats and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and fragrant, around 2 minutes. This toasting step greatly enhances the flavour of the oats.
Stir the oats into the simmering water/milk mixture. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer gently for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is very thick.

Stir in salt. Continue to simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally and reducing heat as necessary to prevent scorching on the bottom, until almost all of the liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. If you double the recipe, the oatmeal might need an extra 5 minutes cooking time. The oatmeal will be very creamy when it's done.
Remove from heat and stir in any mix-ins that you'd like. Let the oatmeal rest for 5 minutes before serving so it has more time to thicken up and cool down a palatable temperature.
Let any extra oatmeal cool completely before covering and refrigerating for future breakfasts.
Heat oven to 450F. Cut chicken into at least 8 pieces: 2 wings, 4 legs pieces, 2 breasts. Remove backbone. Freeze the 2 breasts, they're not the best for stock.

Place chicken pieces (backbone too) on top of a parchment lined and oil baking pan. Add any vegetables scraps you have around; I like carrots, mushroom stems and sliced onions or shallots. Add cardamon, coriander and cloves to taste. Less is more, too many cloves can overpower the stock. Just a very small handful of whole spices well work.
Place in oven roast for 20 - 25 minutes until nice and brown.
Add everything, including scrapings from the pan to a stock pot and cover with water, bring to a simmer for at least 4 - 5 hours.
With about an hour to go, add the ginger (2 - 3 tablespoons) and 2 - 3 garlic cloves . This adds some extra aromatics to the stock.
Strain off stock. Pick all the meat off the bones and save for soup. Refrigerate or freeze.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook, stirring, until al dente.

Combine pork with 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet and cook, stirring frequently, over medium heat, until fat has rendered and pork is crisp. In a large metal heatproof mixing bowl, whisk together eggs and yolks, cheese with fresh black pepper.

Using tongs and/or a strainer, transfer pasta to skillet with crisped pork and its fat; be sure retain a least 2 cups of the pasta water. Add remaining olive oil to the cooked pasta and stir to combine; let cool slightly. Scrape pasta, pork and all the fat into the egg mixture. Measure 1/2 cup of pasta water and add to pasta and egg mixture. Stir to combine.

Set mixing bowl over pot of boiling pasta water (make sure bottom of bowl does not touch the water) and cook, stirring quickly with tongs, until sauce thickens to a creamy, silkly consistency and leaves trails as you stir. (You can adjust the 'silkiness' at this stage by adding more pasta water). Remove from heat, season with salt and divide into bowls. Serve right away, topping with more graded cheese and freshly ground black pepper as desired.
Add enough water to fully cover lentils in a deep pot and cook, covered, over medium-high heat for 30-45 minutes, or until tender (but not falling apart).
Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and vinegar. Set aside.
In a medium mixing bowl, combine cooked lentils, green onions, parsley, red onion and carrot. Drizzle olive oil mixture over salad and toss well. Season to taste with kosher salt and pepper.
Refrigerate, covered, for at least 30-45 minutes to chill, preferably 2-3 hours to allow flavours to meld.

recipe.title: Lentil and Mushroom Wellington with Mushroom Gravy

prep.step: Preheat the oven to 400F. Put butter into a large skillet set over medium-high heat, add a drizzle of oil and saute the onion for 4-5 minutes, or until soft. Roughly chop and add the msuhrooms along with the garlic, thyme and rosemary and cook, seasoning with salt and pepper, until the mushrooms start to turn golden and excess liquid has evaported. Transfer to a bowl, reserving a couple of spoonfuls if you like to stir into the gravy, and stir in the lentils. Set aside to cool completely.

Unroll your thawed pastry, or cut the block in half and roll each piece into a 10x10 inch square. If you're using it, spread or drop the goat cheese in spoonfuls down one third of each peice of pastry. Spoon the mushroom-lentil filling down the middle. Fold the goat cheese side over the mushrooms, and roll it over to form a log. Transfer to a parchment-lined cooking sheet and tuck under the ends.

In a small dish, lightly beat the egg with a spoonful of water. Brush over the Wellingtons and lightly score the with a sharp knife, allowing it to slice through in a few places. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until deep golden.

Meanwhile, return the skillet to the stovetop over medium-high heat and sprinkle the flour over the bottem of the pan. Let it sit for a minute, until it starts to turn golden. Whisk in the remaining tablespoon of butter and stock. Bring to a simmer, whisking constantly, until the gravy bubbles and thickens. Whisk in the soy sauce and continue to cook, stirring often, until the gravy darkens and reduces. Stir in any mushrooms you set aside.

ingredients.item: flank steak, sliced across the grain to bite size

prep.step: Heat up pressure cooker: press Saute to medium or high heat. Wait for the Instant Pot indicator read HOT.
Add sliced beef to a large ziplock bag and add 1 tablespoon cornstarch and shake well to coat the beef evenly.

Add the oil to the hot Instant Pot, once oil is hot, add the beef and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring a few times. If needed brown the beef in batches, you don't want to add too much as it will start releasing juice and it won't brown well.
NOTE: Your can skip browning the beef and just add it to the pot.
If bits of beef stick to the pot, add 1/2 cup water and deglaze the pot. Using a wooden spoon scrape the bottom of the pot. Discard that liquid if wanted.
Add the rest of the ingredients to the pot: garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, water, rice wine and pepper flakes.
Stir well until all ingredients are combined and coated in sauce.
Close lid and pressure cook at High Pressure for 8 minutes + 10 minutes Natural Release. Turn off the heat. Release the remaining pressure after the 10 minutes. Open the lid.

Make the cornstarch slurry, in a small bowl mix cornstarch with the water until fully combined. With the Instant Pot on the saute function, add the slurry to the pot, stir to combine and cook for 2 - 3 minutes on saute, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens. Turn off Instatnt Pot and let the Mongolian Beef sit for 8 - 10 minutes before serving, in this time the sauce will settle and thicken more.
Serve over rice and garnish with fresh chopped gree onions and sesame seeds.
Bring a large pot of water to boil, using at least 6 cups per 1 cup of rice. Rinse the rice in a fine mesh colander under running water to remove excess starch.
Add rice to the boiling water. Reduce the temperature as necessary to prevent overflow, but maintain a steady boil, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Drain off the remaining cooking water and return the rice to the pot. Cover the pot and let the rice rest, off the heat, for 10 minutes. Fluff, season as desired.

Preheat the oven to 375F. Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside. Process rolled oats in a blender or food processor until almost a powder, combine with the sifted ingredients.

In a large bowl, cream together the butter, brown and white sugar until smooth. Beat in the eggs one at a time then stir in the vanilla. Gradually stir in the dry ingredients until well blended. Fold in the chocolate chips and pecans. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

ingredients.name: Sauce
ingredients.item: fresh herbs (your choice) to 2 tsp dried herbs

prep.step: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and onion and cook for until translucent. Add tomatoes, water/wine, salt and pepper.
Simmer and reduce. Add herbs. If necessary add 1 tbsp. sugar to cut acidity of tomatoes.
Mince garlic in food processor. Add spinach and remaining ingredients from filling and process until smooth.

To assemble, place 1 - 2 cups of sauce in the bottom of a baking pan that can hold 18 - 21 cannelloni. Transfer the blended filling ingredients to a piping bag or large zip lock bag. If using a zip lock, cut a small diagonal corner from the bag. Fill each cannelloni tube and place in baking pan. Place remaining sauce over all the tubes. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and scatter with cheese. Return to oven for 10 minutes until the cheese is melted.

ingredients.item: freshly squeezed lime juice - reserve 1 slice
Garnish with lime twist or slice

prep.step: Add bourbon and lime juice to a cocktail shaker and fill with ice. Shake until well chilled. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass. Top with ginger beer and garnish with lime twist.

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, cut into 1/4 inch cubes

prep.step: Heat oven to 425F. Place one of the pie crusts into a 9-inch pie dish.
In a small bowl, whisk together white sugar, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Place apicots halves in a separate large bowl and stir in lemon juice.
Add the sugar mixture to the apricots and toss gently to mix.
Pour into pie crust.
Evenly distribute the butter cubes on top of the apricot mixture.
Top the remaining pie crust and crimp the edges to seal. Cut slits in the top of the crust for vents. OR Create a lattice crist topping. OR Top with crumble topping of butter, flour and oatmeal.
Place pie plate on a sheet pan and bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until golden and apricot filling just begins to bubble through the slits.
If using double or lattice crust, sprinkle the top of the pie with 2 teaspoon of demerara or sanding sugar as soon as it comes out of the oven. Cool before serving.

ingredients.name: For The Pickles
ingredients.item: red hot peppers, sliced and cut into rings

prep.step: Wash and scrub cucumbers clean. Cut the ends off, then cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Layer cucumber slices, shallots, and ice cubes in a large deep container or bowl.

Dissolve the pickling salt in the 12 cups of water, then pour over the cucumber mixture. Add more water if necessary to cover. Place a plate on top, and add heavy objects on top to weigh it down and keep cucumbers submerged. Let stand for 30 minutes or for up to 1 hour.
Drain and rinse well. Drain again, gently pressing down on the cucumbers to squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Make the pickling liquid: In a saucepan, bring vinegar, water, sugar, mustard seeds, salt, celery seeds, coriander, turmeric and cloves to boil, stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Tightly pack cucumber mixture into still-hot sterilized jars to within 1 inch or rim, then cover with liquid, leaving 1/2 inch headspace.
Process for 10 minutes in water bath.
Once completely cooled, store pickles at least 1 week before openning. Once opened will keep for a least 1 month in the fridge.

ingredients.item: red bell peppers, halved and seeded

prep.step: In a food processor, coarsely grind tomatoes, bell pepper and onions. Line a large colander with cheesecloth, place in sink or large bowl and pour in tomato mixture to drain.
In a large, non-aluminum stockpot, combine tomato mixture, celery seeds, mustard seed, salt, sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Sterlize enough jars and lids to hold relish. Pack relish into sterlized jars, making sure there are no spaces or air pockets. Fill jars all the way to top. Screw on lids.

Place a rack in the bottom of a large stockpot and fill halfway with boiling water. Lower jars into pot using a holder. Leave 2 inch space between jars. Pour in more boiling water if necessary, until tops of jars covered by 2 inches of water. Bring water to a full boil, cover and process for 30 minutes.

Remove jars from pot and place on cloth-covered or wood surface, several inches apart, until cool. Once cool, press top of each lid with finger, ensuring that seal is tight. Relish can be stored for up to a year.

ingredients.name: Core Ingredients
ingredients.item: thinly sliced green onions, plus more for serving

prep.step: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain
In a large skillet, over medium high heat, add oil and butter. Add shallots and season with salt. Cook until golden and crispy. Tranfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Optional: saute added vegetables, add more oil and butter as required

Add sesame oil to skillet. When oil is fragrant, stir in green onions and garlic cook for about a minute. Add soy sauce, chili garlic sauce, lime juice brown sugar and red pepper flakes (if using). Simmer until sauce is reduced slightly, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add cooked noodles and toss to combine. Garnish with crispy shallots and more green onions.

notes.title: Options: Amounts up to you
notes.content: Vegetables: any combination of red pepper, zucchini, mushrooms, beans, etc...
Cooked meat: thin slices of chicken, pork or beef

ingredients.name: Main Ingredients
ingredients.item: roasted beets, peeled, cubed to 1/2 inch pieces
feta cheese (Blue will work as well)

ingredients.name: Balsamic Vinaigrette (makes more than you'll need

prep.step: Wrap thoroughly washed beets in foil and bake in preheated 425F oven, on a baking sheet for about 1 or 2 hours or until a knife goes into the beet without resistance. Let cool for about 10 minutes then peel the skin off. Must completely cool before proceeding with the recipe.
Cut beets into 1/2 inch cubes, you'll need from 2 - 3 cups.
Once the nuts have cool, roughly chop with a knife.
Assemble all ingredients into a salad. Layer the greens, then beets, top with cheese and chopped nuts.
Salad can be refrigerated until ready to eat. Right before eating, drizzle enough dressing to your liking.

notes.title: How to make the Vinaigrette with hand blender
notes.content: In blender combine and pulse together balsamic vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, salt and garlic clove.
Emulsify the vinaigrette by gradually adding olive oil, a small bit at a time, whilst continuing to mix the contents with the blender.

prep.step: Combine brown sugar, chili powder, paprika, salt, cumin and pepper in a small bowl. Place pork roast in a shallow dish and pat dry with paper towel. Press spice mixture all over pork roast. Cover loosely and refrigerated for at least 30 minutes or for up to 1 day.
Preheat BBQ to medium-high.
Turn one side of BBQ off and maintain 325F.

Place roast, fat-side up over unlit side of BBQ. Cover and grill for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the pork reads 145F (or 137F for medium). Remove and let stand at room temperature for up to 2 hours.

notes.title: Alternative Cooking Method
notes.content: Use a rotisserie on the BBQ. Place a catch pan under the roast to stop any fat from falling onto the cooler side of the BBQ. Cooks through in about 1 hour.

prep.step: In a saucepan, add all ingredients except cherries and heat through. DO NO BOIL!
Turn off heat and add cherries. Let Cool.
Store in a mason jar in refrigerator for several weeks.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: After a couple of days, check the level of liquid in the jar. If the cherries have absorbed enough liquid to lower the level below the cherries add more brandy or vodka to just cover the cherries.

ingredients.item: dessert apples, peeled, cored and quartered

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F.
Roll out your pastry, you need it a little bigger than the frying pan. Set to one side.

Meanwhile take a heavy based non-stick oven proof frying pan, approximately 30cm and add the sugar and let gently dissolve over a medium to low heat, do not stir the pan but just shake the pan until dissolved. Heat until it becomes golden brown.

When the caramel is ready, add the butter, cinnamon and star anise, when the caramel is foaming add the brandy and cook for 2 minutes, arrange the apple quarters in the bottom of the pan and cook for 10 minutes over a low heat.
Carefully top with the puff pastry and tuck the edges in using two spoons. Prick with a small sharp knife.
Put straight in the oven and bake fo 25-35 minutes until the pastry is golden.

Remove from the oven and leave to cool for 5 minutes before placing a plate, slightly larger than the pan, on top of the pastry and very carefully, preferable using oven gloves, invert the tart onto the plate.
Strip and finely chop the rosemary and finely chop the bacon.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large casserole pan on high heat. Once hot add the rosemary and bacon and fry for 2 minutes, or until the bacon starts to crisp up, stirring regularly.
Add all the ground meat, using a wooden spoon to break up it up as you go. Render the heat to medium and cook for at least 10 minutes, or until the liquid has evaporated, stirring occasionally.
Trim and half the carrots, then add to a food processor and blitz to roughly the same size as the ground meat. Peel and halve the onions, add them to the carrot and blitz again.
Tip mixture into pan with ground meat, then blitz then add the celery. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes. or until the vegetables start to soften, stirring regularly.

Add the tomatoes and tomato paste, breaking them up with a spoon. Fill each can with water and tip into the pan. Give everything a good stir and reduce the heat to low. Leave to simmer around 2 hours, or until thickened and reduced, stirring occasionally. Season with freshly ground black pepper and salt to taste.

recipe.title: New Orleans Red Beans with Rice

prep.step: In a skillet over medium heat add butter then stir in onion, bell pepper and garlic, cook until tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove and discard ham hock and bay leave. Cook as much rice as your like.

notes.title: Something to think about
notes.content: Cook the day before you serve. Let it cool and store overnight in the refrigerator. Reheat the next day and something magic happens - the taste gets even better.

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and saute for 2-3 minutes or until soft.
Add garlic, mushrooms, oregano and red pepper flakes and cook for 3-4 minutes or until mushrooms are soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Add marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes on medium-low heat.
Add salt and pepper.
In a large mixing bowl combine spinach, ricotta, parmesan, egg and mix well.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, cover the bottom with about 1 1/2 cups of meat sauce.
Take four noodles and spread about half of the cheese/spinach mixture on them.
Place the noodles on top of the meat sauce.
Top with about 1/2 of the remaining meat sauce mixture.
Take another four noodles and spread the remaining cheese mixture on top, place them in the dish.
Place the last four noddles on top of the cheese mixture.
Pour all of the remaining sauce over the noodles.
Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Cover dish loosely with aluminum foil and bake for 40 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly bubbly.
Allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

ingredients.item: leeks, white & light green parts only, roughly chopped
(1 k) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and roughly chopped into 1/2-inch pieces
low sodium chicken or vegetarian broth

prep.step: Melt the butter over medium heat in a large soup pot. Add the leeks and garlic and cook, stirring regularly, until soft and wilted, about 10 minutes. Adjust the heat as necessary so as not to brown.
Add potatoes, broth, bay leaves, thyme, salt and pepper to pot and bring to boil. Cover and turn the heat down to low. Simmer for 15 minutes or until potoatoes are very soft.

Fish out the thyme and bay leafs, then puree the soup with a hand-held immersion blender until smooth. (Alternatively, use a standard blender to puree the soup in batches, see note.) Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper. If soup i too thin, simmer until thickened. It it's too thick, add water or stock to thin it out. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.

notes.title: If using a standard blender to puree the soup
notes.content: Be sure not to fill the jar more than halfway; leave the hole in the lid open and cover loosely with a dishtowel to allow the heat to escape; and pour blended soup into a clean pot.

prep.step: Lay scallops on a cutting board and score scallops going about 1/2 through.
Place scallops in bowl and drizzle with olive oil, salt and pepper, finely grated lemon zest and dust with 5-spice powder. Drizzle with sesame oil and toss to coat.

Heat frying pan on high heat and add a couple tablespoons of olive oil. Add scallops scored side down. Cook 2 or 3 minutes until scallops are golden brown. Turn scallops and cook for about 30 seconds, remove and rest.

Squeeze lemon and reserve juice. In a small saucepan stir together butter, garlic and hot peppers. Add lemon juice and honey and, if necessary, additional butter. Heat until melted and drizzle over cooked scallops.

notes.title: Amount of ingredients
notes.content: The amount of spices is optional. It depends upon how spicy you want to make the dish. Sesame oil is very powerful, a little goes a long way. Same with the amount of hot chiles; more heat, more chiles. Sweeter; more honey. Taste, taste, taste! That's how you season the dish.

ingredients.item: salt and pepper for seasoning ribs

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F.
Season all sides of the short ribs liberally with salt and pepper
Heat a heavy, oven-safe pot over high heat. Add olive oil and allow to heat briefly. Sear short ribs in olive oil, about 1 minutes per side. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add in onion and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add garlic and saute, about 1 minute, DO NOT BURN.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a simmer, Add meat and place rosemary on top.
Cover and place in oven for at least 2 hours, check for tenderness. Ribs are done when they pull easily from the bone.

notes.title: Things to consider
notes.content: When done the ribs will look very dark, they're not burnt, it's the worcestershire sauce.
Season the ribs with more salt and pepper than you think is necessary you'll be rewarded with tasty ribs.
Every oven is different so 1 1/2 hours in check the pot. Add more broth if necessary.

ingredients.name: Spice Rub
ingredients.item: kosher salt, plus more if needed

prep.step: Place all of the barbecue sauce ingredients in a 3-quart or large slow cooker and stir to combine.
Place all of the measured rub ingredients except the brisket in a medium bowl and stir to combine.
Place the brisket on a cutting board and cut in half widthwise. Evenly coat it with the spice rub and place the two pieces in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low until fork tender, about 10 hours.
Transfer to a clean cutting board. Pour the barbecue sauce from the slow cooker into a medium heatproof bowl and set aside.
Remove the excess fat from the brisket and discard. Slice the meat against the grain into 1/4 inch-thick pieces and return to slow cooker. Alternatively, you can spred the meat using 2 forks.

Use a spoon to skim and discard the fat from the surface of the barbecue sauce. Return the sauce to the slow cooker and stir gently to combine it with the meat. Taste and season with salt and pepper as needed.

Place the water, chickpeas, and baking soda in a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 hours, or on low heat for 8 to 9 hours, or until tender. Drain and serve immediately or freeze for up to a month.

Reduce heat to medium. Add onions and cook, stirring until softened. Add garlic, cumin, oregano, pepper and salt and cook, stirring for about 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook until desired consistency is achieved. Add 1 cup of beer or broth and bring to boil. Reserve extra to top up if necessary.
Pour mixture over beef. Add beans and stir well. Cover and cook on Low for 8 to 10 hours or on High for 4 to 5 hours, until beef is tender.
Cook rice. In a small skillet, saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Stir in soup, mushrooms and rice.
Sprinkle inside and outside of birds with salt and pepper. Stuff with rice mixture. Place on a rack in a greased shallow roasting pan; cover with foil.
Bake at 350F for 40 minutes. Remove foil and brush melted butter over hens. Bake 25-35 minutes or longer or until juices run clear and a thermomter reads 180F for hens and 165F for stuffing.
Bring salted water to boil add rice and cook for about 5 to 6 minutes until rice is almost cooked through.
Cook the onion in butter until light golden brown. Mix rice and cooked onion. Season well with salt, pepper, garlic and paprika. Set aside to cool.
Remove core from cabbage. Place cabbage in a deep pot and filed with boiling water. Let it stand until the leaves are soft and pliable.
Drain the cabbage and take the leaves apart very carefully without tearing them. If you can, set aside some of the large leaves to use later. Cut off the hard centre rib from each leaf.

Place a generous spoonful of filling on each leaf and roll lightly. Arrange the rolls in layers in the pot. Sprinkle each layer with some salt. Combine the tomato juice/sauce with sour cream and pour over the rolls. The liquid should barely show between the rolls. Protect the top from scorching by covering it with a few large leaves.
Cover the rolls tightly and bake in a 350F oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until both the cabbage and filling are cooked.

notes.title: Rice and Meat OR Bacon Filling
notes.content: Add 1/2 pound of cooked ground ham or beef OR 1/2 cup or more of chopped crisp bacon to rice filling.

ingredients.item: white beans: Navy, Kidney or Pinto
savoy cabbage, cored and cut into chiffonade
Swiss Chard, stemmed and cut into chiffonade
water, or light stock of your choice
salt and black pepper to taste

prep.step: Cover the beans with water and soak them overnight. Cook the beans with the bay leaves and 2 of the garlic cloves until they are soft, about 1 hour. Strain them, reserving 1 cup of the liquid to add to the soup.
In a food processor, shred the remaining 2 cloves of garlic with the celery, carrot, onion and leek until very fine; still with tiny pieces of the vegetables, not a puree.
Saute the vegetables in 1/4 cup of olive oil on medium-low heat, about 10 minutes, or until it is fragrant and slightly colored.
Add the cooked beans and the 1 cup cooking water, cabbage, chard and water (stock). Bring to a simmer and cook for approximately one hour. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Crumble the stale bread into small chunks and place a handful of the bread in each bowl. Ladle the soup over it and let it sit for a few minutes for the bread to soften and the broth to be absorbed. Finish each bowl with extra virgin olive oil and freah ground black pepper.

ingredients.item: pastry for a double-crust 9 inch pie

prep.step: Preheat oven to 425F.
Stir together flour, 1 cup sugar and cinnamon and set aside.
Wash, peel and slice fresh peaches.
Mix together peaches with the combined dry ingredents. Exclude sugar for the top.
Turn into pastry-lined pie pan and dot with butter.
Cover with top crust,cut slits in it, seal the edges.
Sprinkle top with 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Cover the edges with foil to prevent over browning; remove foil for the last 15 minutes of baking.
Baking 35 to 45 minutes (or more) until crust is brown and juice begins to bubble through the slits in the crust.
Pie may be frozen for future use.
BOTTOM LAYER: Melt first 3 ingredients in a double boiler.
Add egg and stir to cook and thicken.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients and press firmly into an ungreased 9x9 inch pan.
MIDDLE LAYER: Cream all ingredients together; beat until light.
Spread over bottom layer.
TOPPING: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat; cool.
When cool but still runny, spread over middle layer.
Chill in refrigerator.
Use a very sharp knife to cut into squares.
Place the chickpeas in a medium bowl and cover with 2 inches of cold water. Soak overnight.

Place the cumin and coriander seeds in an 8-inch cast-iron skillet and set over medium high heat. Cook, shaking the pan frequently, until the seeds give off an aroma and just begin to brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer the toasted spices to a spice grinder and process until finely ground. Set aside.

Drain the chickpeas. Rinse with fresh water. Combine the soaked chickpeas, ground cumin and coriander, garlic and scallions, salt, pepper, baking powder, cayenne pepper and parsley leaves in medium mixing bowl.

Pass this mixture through a meat grinder or stand mixer with the grinder attachment fitted with the smallest die. Alternatively, you can divide the mixture in half and process one half at a time in a food processor, pulsing 10 to 20 times.

Scoop the mixture into 1 1/2 to 2-ounce portions using a 2-inch diameter cookie. Place on a half sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Can be held hold at room tempearture for up to 2 hours before frying, or covered in the refrigerator overnight.

Heat the peanut oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over high heat until it reaches 350F. Adjust the heat to maintain temperature. Gently place the falafel, 1 at a time, into the hot oil. Fry 4 at a time until deep golden brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove to a half sheet pan lined with a cooling rack and topped with a paper towel to drain. Repeat until all falafel have been cooked.

ingredients.item: boiling water (or stock of your choice)

prep.step: Combine bulgur and boiling water and let soak until all water absorbed. Drain well and squeeze any excess water.
In a large bowl combine bulgur, parsley, mint, green onion, tomatoes, cucumber, salt, cumin, pepper and lemon juice.
Chill for an hour. Immediately before serving add olive oil.

Heat the oven on broil to 390F or simply use the high setting if your oven doesn't have the option to choose the temperature when broiling. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place the peppers on the tray. Place tray in the oven on the rack that allows the peppers to be closest to the broiler without touching. Cook for 30 minutes, rotating the peppers every 10 minutes to ensure even colouring. The peppers should be roasted and blackened all over.
Carefully remove the peppers from the oven. Transfer them to a bowl and cover them with a plate or a lid and allow to sit and steam for 10 minutes.
Peel the blackened skin from each of the peppers. Remove any stems and seeds and discard.
Dice the peppers and then continue to chop until a chunky paste is achieved. Place in a bowl and add the olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, chili flakes and black pepper. Stir to combine.
To make the yogurt,combine all ingredients in a bowl and gentle fold together until just combined.

Layer a serving bowl with the feta, mint, yogurt and the marinated red peppers. Drizzle with a healthy dose of extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with chili flakes as garnish. Serve with crackers, or chips, or cucumber slices or anything else flat and scoopable

notes.title: Alternative method of roasting Red Peppers
notes.content: If you have a gas stove, set as many burners as required on medium high flame and place the each pepper on top of a burner. As the peppers begin to blacken, rotate 1/4 turn until completely blackened. It should take about 5 to 10 minutes. Place blackened peppers in a bowl, cover and let steam and then cool.

prep.step: To make pastry, combine the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add the butter and rub into the flour until mixture resembles coarse meal. Drizzle in enough water until the dough begins to hold together. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a disc (do not overwork the dough). Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut out 3 inch rounds and line 12 muffin cups with the dough. Chill.
Whisk together eggs and brown sugar. Add the salt, vinegar, maple syrup and melted butter; combine well. In a small bowl mix together walnuts, currants and raisins.
Divide the walnut-fruit mixture between the tart shells. Fill each tart with approximately 1/4 cup filling. Bake in a preheated 350F oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until set.
Soak beans in water overnight.

Drain and rinse beans. Add beans to a pot with 1/2 head of garlic and bay leaves and just cover with water. Cook on a low simmer for about 3 hours or cooked through. Drain beans and reserve 1 cup of the liquid and 1/2 head of garlic.
In a Dutch Oven, heat olive oil. Squeeze flesh of garlic into oven, add sage, and cook until fragrant. Add beans and reserved liquid. Cook on medium 10 minutes.
Add sauce,vsalt and pepper and cook 20 minutes or until thickened.
Serve alone or with hardy stew.

In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In a separate bowl whisk together buttermilk, egg, butter and vanilla; pour over dry ingredients. Whisk until combined but still slightly lumpy.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over low-medium heat;ligthly brush with some of the oil. Pour batter, 1/4 cup at a time into pan, spread slightly to form pancakes.
Cook until bubbles appear on top, about 3 - 4 minutes. Flip and cook until bottoms are golden brown. Transfer to rimmed baking sheet; cover and keep warm in 250F oven.
Toss together chicken pieces, pepper, salt, paprika, rosemary, thyme, oregano, sage, white pepper and cayenne pepper in a large bowl to coat.
Stir in buttermilk until chicken is coated. Refrigerate for 6 hours (over night is OK)
Combine flour, salt, paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, white pepper and onion powder in a large shallow dish.
Remove chicken from the buttermilk and dredge each piece in the seasoned flour. Shake off any excess and transfer to a plate.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven to 350F. Add all the chicken to the pan and cook for 10 minutes.
Turn chicken pieces and cook for another 10-15 minutes.
Remove chicken from the oil and transfer to a cooling rack set over a paper towel lined baking sheet. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Saute both in a large pot with olive oil over medium heat until softened. Dice the celery while the onions and garlic are sauteing, then add to the pot and continue to saute for 2-3 minutes more.
Add the cumin, turmeric, cinnamon and cayenne pepper to the pot. Stir and cook the spices with the vegetables for 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes (with juices), chickpeas (rinsed and drained if from a can) and cauliflower florets. Stir the pot until everything is well mixed.
