Add the stock and bay leaf, turn the heat up to high, place a lid on the pot and allow it to come to a boil. Once it reached a boil, add the lentils. Stir and let it come back up to a boil, then turn the heat down to low. Simmer on low, with the lid on, for 30 minutes.
After simmering for 30 minutes the lentils should be tender. Remove bay leaf and give the stew a taste. Add salt and pepper, if needed, to taste.

ingredients.item: chicken breast filets, pounded evenly to 1cm thickeness

prep.step: Combine all dry ingredients. Place the mixture, eggs and panko into separate shallow dishes. Dredge chicken in flour mixture, then dip in eggs, followed by the panko, making sure each filet is covered evenly on both sides.

Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Carefully lay two filets down in the hot oil and cook until golden brown and chicken is fully cooked, around 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Carefully remove cooked filets from the hot oil and place on paper-towel lined tray to soak up any excess oil.

ingredients.name: Turkey
ingredients.item: boneless turkey breast, 4 to 5 lbs, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness

prep.step: Preheat oven to 325F. Place a baking rack on a baking sheet.

Lay the butterflied turkey breast skin-side down on a cutting board. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper. Evenly spread the stuffing in a 1/2-inch thick layer over the meat, leaving a 1/2-inch border on all sides. Make sure not to mound it. Roll the turkey like a jelly roll, tucking in the ends. Tie the roast firmly with the Butcher's twine every 2 inches to make a compact cylinder.

Place the stuffed turkey breast seam-side down on the rack on the baking sheet. Brush with olive oil, sprinkle with a bit more salt and pepper, and roast for 1 3/4 to 2 hours, until an instant-read thermometer registers 150F in the centre. Tent with foil and allow to rest at room temperature for 15 minutes.

For the gravy, to a small saucepan over medium-high heat, add the chicken stock and brandy. Bring to a boil then lower to a simmer until mixture is noticeably reduced. Stir together cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl and whisk into sauce. Whisk in mustard and thyme and simmer for 2 minutes more. Turn off heat and whisk in butter. Taste for seasoning.
Once the turkey has rested, snip and remove all butcher twine. Slice roulade into nice even pieces and serve drizzled with gravy.

notes.title: Additions
notes.content: Simple additions to round out the dinner include a loaf of crusty sourdough baguette, steamed broccoli and seasoned hothouse tomatoes.

ingredients.item: melted butter, or as needed, divided

prep.step: Preheat ovento 400F, Generously grease a 12-cup muffing tin with melted butter, reserving the rest for the potatoes.

Slice potatoes to about 1/8 inch thickness using a mandoline. Place slices in a bowl and add rosemary, salt, pepper and cayenne pepper. Drizzle in the remaining melted butter. Using your hands toss to evenly distribute and separate all the potato slices. Grate about 1/4 of the cheese over the potatoes. Toss. Add more cheese; toss again. Continue until all the cheese is incorporated.
Stack potato slices in uneven layers (to resemble flower petals) in prepared muffing tin, ending with some of the smaller pieces.

Bake in preheated oven until potatoes are tender, 45 to 60 minutes, testing with a skewer for doneness. Potatoes should be very soft. If potatoes look too brown but aren't yet cooked through, cover pan with foil for the final minutes of baking.
Loosen edges of potatoes roses with a fork and lift out of pan to serving dish.
Preheat oven to 375F. Grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish.

In the same skillet, melt 2 more tablespoons butter. Whisk in 2 tablspoons flour. Stirring constantly, cook over medium heat until the flour smells like baked pie crust, about 3 minutes. Slowly whisk in milk, about 1/2 cup at a time, the whisk in nutmeg, cayeene pepper and thyme. Bring to a simmer, and cook until thickened, whisking constantly, 3 more minutes. Transfer to a bowl and reserve.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in clean skillet; stir in panko until all crumbs are coated; reserve.
Bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil over medium heat, and boil beans until bright green and crisp but not raw tasting, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain very well.

Spoon half of the caramelized onions into the prepared casserole dish; top with green beans. Season with salt and black pepper. Spread reserved with sauce over the green beans; sprinkle with half of the Gruyere cheese. Top with the rest of the onions and use the back of a spoon to push onions down into the sauce and cheese. Top with the butter panko crumbs, the remaining Gruyere and Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the oven until hot throughtout and lightly browned, about 30 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350F. Line a 8-inch square baking dish with a strip of parchment paper, letting it hang over both sides. Butter the pan.

In a saucepan, bring the dates, water, lemon juice and brown sugar to a boil. Add the baking soda and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the dates have fallen apart. Let cool.
In a bowl, combine the oats, flour, brown sugar and baking powder. Add the butter and stir to combine.

Spread half the crisp in the pan and press firmly. Layer with the date mixture. Cover with the remaining crisp and press lightly. Bake for about 55 minutes or until the crisp is golden brown. Let cool on a wire rack for about 4 hours or overnight.

recipe.title: Beef Stew with Bacon and Mustard

ingredients.item: thick slab bacon, cut into 1/2 inch lardons
boneless chuck, cut into 2 inch pieces
onion, peeled and coarsely chopped (about 1 1/2 cups)
large garlic, peeled and minced (about 2 tbsp.)
cremini mushrooms, trimmed and cut in half

prep.step: In large stockpot, cook bacon over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the bacon just turns crips and brown. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Pat beef dry with paper towels, then season generously with salt and pepper. Heat pot over high heat and cook the meat in batches to avoid crowding the pot, leaving ample room between pieces, and turn it as it cooks so that all sides are browned. Each batch should take a total of 3 to 4 minutes; as soon as it's ready, transfer the batch to a large bowl and then continue with the next one. You may need to add more fat if the pot becomes too dry during cooking. Once all of the meat has been cooked, pour off fat and reserve. Pour in 1 cup stock, and bring to a boil over high heat. Deglaze pot, scraping up browned bits from the bottom. Pour this over the meat in the bowl.

Add olive oil to pot over low heat. Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, and cook,stirring, until fragrant. Stir in the mushrooms and cook until they begin to soften, about 2 minutes. (If the bottom of the pot is turning too dark, or the onions begin to stick, stir in about 1/4 cup stock.)

Once the vegetables have softened, stir in the flour and mustard, and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Pour in 2 cups stock. Return the beef to the pot along with any juices that have accumulated in the bowl. Pour in 2 cups red wine. Add the herbs and bring the liquid to a full boil before reducing the heat so the stew is at a simmer. Cover pot, and simmer until the meat is tender (it should pull apart easily with a fork) about 1 hour.

Put the potatoes and onions in the pot. If necessary add more stock so everything is covered for even cooking. Simmer, partially covered, until potatoes are just tender when pierced with a knife, about 25 minutes. You'll need to give the pot a good stir every now and then. Once vegetables are tender, stir in cooked bacon.

ingredients.item: slab bacon, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
white pearl onions, blanched and peeled

prep.step: Place chicken in a large bowl,and add wine. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 325F.
Remove chicken from wine, and pat dry; reserve wine. Season with salt and pepper.

Cook bacon in a Dutch oven over medium-low heat until crisp, about 20 minutes. Transfer bacon to a plate, leaving drippings in pot. (You should about 3 tablespoons; you may need to add the olive oil.)

Raise heat to medium-high. Working in batches, cook chicken, flipping once, until golden brown, 4 to minutes per side. Transfer to a plate. Add chopped onions to pot and cook 4 - 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes. Add pearl onions and mushrooms and cook until brown, 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and flour and cook 2 minutes.

Return bacon and chicken to pot. Add thyme and bay leaves. Strain reserved wine and add to pot. Bring to a simmer. Cover and place in oven until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Serve over mashed potatoes.

ingredients.item: chicken, cubed into bit size pieces
butter, divided for saute and sauce

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F.
Melt a few tablespoons of butter in a large (4 to 6 quart) saucepan. Caramelize onion and garlic, about 15 minutes.
Stir in remaining butter add masala and cayenne pepper. Allow to melt: Add evaporated milk, cream, tomato sauce and bring mixture to a simmer. DO NOT ALLOW MIXTURE TO BOIL
Meanwhile place cubed chicken in a bowl and add oil and curry, mix well. Place on a cooking sheet, single layer and bake in oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool.
Add cooled chicken to sauce and allow to simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over rice or broad noddles.

notes.title: Chicken Selection
notes.content: You can mix breast with thigh to get a tastier combination.

ingredients.item: broccoli florets, cut into bite size pieces

prep.step: In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the butter. Add in the flour and stir until blended; do not brown. Remove from heat and set aside.

In a large saucepan, melt 4 tbsp. of butter. Add onion; cook until tender. Add chopped broccoli florets, cook and stir about 6 minutes. Add the chicken broth. Increase the heat at the this point and bring to boil. Whisk constantly, add the flour mixture. Cook and stir until soup is thickened and bubbly.
Add in the salt, pepper and half-and-half. Heat through and serve hot.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: Soup will thicken upon standing. You can substitute cauliflower or broccoflower in place of broccoli.

prep.step: Combine lentils, barley, and broth in large Dutch Oven. Bring mixture to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare vegetables.
In large frying pan over medium high heat cook hamburger until juices run clear.
Add beef, vegetables and all remaining ingredients to Dutch Oven. If necessary, break up tomatoes with wooden spoon.
Bring mixture to boil, then reduce to a nice simmer, stirring occasionally until vegetables are tender and soup is thickened.

ingredients.item: large green bell peppers, seeded and chopped

prep.step: Place beans in a large bowl; cover with water and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Drain before cooking.

Place drained beans in a large Dutch Oven; add water to cover. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, and cover the pan. Simmer the beans for about 45 minutes, or until they are tender. Bean skins should bursting when you blow on a few in a spoon. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Set beans aside.
In a large skillet add oil and saute chopped onions and peppers until softened, stirring frequently. Add the garlic and chopped parsley and cook for 2 more minutes.

In a large skillet melt margarine or butter. Add the beef and cook, stirring and breaking up, until no longer pink. Add the onion and pepper mixture to the beef; stir in chili powder and cook for 10 minutes. Add beef mixture to beans and stir in the pepper, cumin and salt to taste.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove cover and continue cooking for 30 minutes or until thickened.

Combine all of the chimichurri ingredients (except salt and pepper) in a food processor. Pulse until mixture resembles pesto, scraping down sides as necessary. Season generously with salt and pepper. Turn it out into a small bowl.

notes.title: Note
notes.content: Use as a marinade on steaks. Also can be used to top toasted french bread from BBQ.

prep.step: In a mixing bowl cream first five ingredients at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and creamy. Combine flour, baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture, beating on low speed until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Use measured scoops to evenly measure dough on to a baking sheet.
Bake at 375F for 9 to 12 minutes or until light golden. Cool 5 minutes on pan, then remove to wire rack and cool completely.

ingredients.item: loosely acked fresh mint or parsley
zest and juice of one lemon

prep.step: In a large bowl combine mint/parsley, feta, lemon juice and zest, yogurt, oil and salt. Add kale, onion, cucumber and tomatoes and toss to coat. Crumble bulgur into mixture
Season to taste with salt and pepper, add more olive oil if necessary. Let sit for a few minutes
Combine flour, cornstarch, icing sugar and nuts in a large bowl. With large spoon, blend in butter. Work with hands until soft, smooth dough forms.
Shape dough into a smooth roll about 1- 1 1/2" in diameter. Wrap and chill until (about 4 hours or overnight). Store rolls in refrigerator for up to a month.
Cut with sharp knife into thin slices. Place on un-greased baking sheet, bake at 375F for 8 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Remove from sheet and cool completely.

notes.title: Variation: Cherry Pecan Shortbread
notes.content: Mix dough until smooth then mix 3/4 cup chopped candied cherries and 1/2 cup chopped pecans until evenly distributed.

ingredients.item: chopped red chili or chili flakes

prep.step: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and chili and cook until garlic is very soft. Do not over cook garlic!
Meanwhile, cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and reserve cooking water.
Toss pasta in flavoured oil adding cooking water and cheese until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Sprinkle plate with grated cheese and parsley.

ingredients.item: medium onions, cut into even slices

prep.step: Preheat oven to 425F. Place sliced onions in two rows in a heavy-duty roasting pan to form a bed beneath the bird.

Put the peeled garlic, herbs and lemon inside the chicken cavity. To help release the lemon's juices, roll it back and forth with the palm of your hand pressing on top then pierce the surface all over with a fork.
Salt and pepper outside of chicken to taste. Place chicken on the bed of onions slices breast-side up, then brings legs forward, cross them and tie together with kitchen twine.
Bake in oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until internal temperature reaches 165F. Remove for oven and pan, cover and let stand for a minimum of 20 minutes.

Mix together all ingredients. Wrap in plastic wrap and cool in refridgerator for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350F. On flour surface roll dough to 1/8" thickness. Cook for 8 minutes or until lightly browned around edges.
In a large bowl, combine the sugar, flour rhubarb and strawberries. Spoon into a 9 inch short crust pie shell.
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar and flour. Cut in the butter until mixture has crumble texture. Sprinkle on top of pie.
Bake for 15 minutes in 450F oven. Reduce the heat to 350F and continue baking for another 30 minutes or until juices are bubbling and rhubarb is cooked. Serve hot or cold

notes.title: Note
notes.content: A good rhubarb pie should be slightly runny and slightly tart. Pink hothouse rhubarb is sweeter and less watery than the greener garden rhubarb. Increase the sugar by about 1/2 a cup and flour by 2 tbsp. for garden variety. Store brought pie crust works well with this but making your own is always preferable.

prep.step: In large saucepan, melt butter; stir in cocoa. Add peanut butter, honey and sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until hot and smooth. Remove from heat.
Add cereal, nuts and vanilla; stir until well-combined. Press lightly into un-greased 9-inch (23 cm) square baking pan.
Chill 2 hours or until set. Cut into squares. Store covered in refrigerator.

recipe.title: Chili Con Carne with Popped Beans

prep.step: Peel and finely chop the onions, garlic, parsley and chilies (deseed the chilies first). Over medium heat place a large sturdy pot and, when hot, add 1 tbsp. olive oil followed by onions, garlic, parsley and chilies. Cook for about 10 minutes or until the onions are soft by not coloured.
Peel and finely chop the carrots and stir them into the pot along with the paprika, cinnamon stick and half the cumin seeds. Fry for 5 minutes.
Add meat, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Cook until the any liquid has evaporated and the meat has browned.

Add about 1/2 to 1 cup of a liquid (water, beer, stock of your choice), along with canned tomatoes, breaking them up with a wooden spoon. Season well with salt and pepper and bring to boil. Reduce to a simmer and leave for 1 to 2 hours to thicken.

Meanwhile, char the bell peppers on the stovetop until blackened all over. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave to steam. Once cool, peel skin, deseed and cut into strips and add to chili.

notes.title: Popped Beans
notes.content: Just near the end of the chili being finished put a large dry non-stick pan over medium heat and toast remaining cumin seeds for a couple of minutes. Drain and add kidney beans, frying and tossing until crisp and starting to pop. Season well and place in serving bowl with a nice bunch of coarsely chopped parsley.

prep.step: In a large pot over high heat, combine beans and water to cover and bring to a boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat but let sit for 1 hour. Drain beans and place them in a slow cooker. Add the ham hocks, onion, brown sugar, maple syrup, salt and water.

Mix well, cover and cook on high setting for 4 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally. During the final hour of cooking, add the ketchup and mustard, remove the ham from the hocks and discard the hocks. Mix well and serve.

notes.title: Substitutions
notes.content: You can easily substitute 1 pound bacon for ham hock.

prep.step: In a large soup pot over medium high heat, add oil. Add onion and saute until golden brown.

Add garlic, curry, cumin, sugar, cayenne pepper stirring constantly for 30 seconds. Add squash, stock, water and apples, bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes or until squash is tender. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 15 to 20 minutes.
Puree with hand blender or food processor add salt and pepper to taste.
Slightly reheat the soup and slowly add as much cream as you prefer. Adds a creamy deep favour.

ingredients.item: coarse sea salt and fresh ground pepper

prep.step: Bring barley and 3 cups water to boil. Add 1/2 tsp. salt. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until barley is tender, about 40 minutes. Drain if necessary.
Meanwhile, place onion in a large bowl and whisk in mustard, oil, 3/4 tsp. salt and 1/2 tsp. pepper.
Stir in barley and herbs. Serve warm.

notes.title: Note
notes.content: Use any type of tender green herb you have on hand, such as basil, mint, chive, parsley or dill.

prep.step: In a 9 inch pan heat almonds, sugar and butter over medium heat stirring constantly until golden brown.
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla.
Spread mixture in pan, sprinkle with salt.
Cool completely, break into smaller pieces.

Combine vinegar, sugar, salt, garlic and oregano in a large stainless steel saucepan. Tie peppercorns and bay leaves in a large square of cheesecloth, creating a spice bag. Add spice bag to saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Stir in tomatoes, carrots, celery, onion and peppers. Boil gently, stirring frequently, 1 hour. Discard spice bag.

Ladle relish into a hot jar to within 1/2 inch of top of rim. Remove any air bubbles by sliding a rubber spatula between glass and food; if necessary, readjust head space to 1/2 inch. Place jars in canner.
Cover canner; return water to boil; process 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1,000 ft (305 m). Remove screw band, dry and store in cool dry place.

notes.title: Note
notes.content: Just before serving, toss this relish with drained, canned mushrooms, artichokes and anchovies or tuna plus olive oil and herbs to taste.

ingredients.item: Italian sausage, saute and cut into bite size pieces

prep.step: In a large skillet, heat oil over moderately high heat. Add onion, garlic, peppers, celery and chilies. Saute, stirring frequently for 7 minutes or until onions just begins to turn golden.

In 4 quart casserole add the thyme, cumin, salt, stock, soup, rice and beans. Add saute vegetables and sausages; baked, covered, in 350F oven for about 1 1/2 hours, or until rice absorbs all the liquid.
Heat butter in large stock pot over low heat. Add shallots and garlic, cook until tender.
Add potato and leeks, cook for 10 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally.
Add stock, salt and pepper and bring to boil. Reduce to simmer, add mushrooms and cook until potato is tender (around 15 minutes).
When potatoes are done, whiz with blender or immersion blender, add milk/cream, taste, adjust salt and pepper if needed.

ingredients.item: grated cheddar or gruyere cheese and pinch of nutmeg

prep.step: Cut an X in base of sprouts. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add sprouts and boil until crisp/tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and run under cold water to cool. Drain again. Slice sprouts into quarters.

Heat butter in pot on medium heat. Add flour and stir together. Add milk, bring to boil stirring and beat in cream, mustard, nutmeg and cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Combine with sprouts in buttered gratin dish. Bake in 350 oven for 20 minutes or until heated through.

In a large saucepan, combine rhubarb, brown sugar, raisins, onion, vinegar, allspice, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat and boil gently stirring frequently. Once the mixture begins to thicken, use an immersion blender to smooth to a consistency of a thin commercial barbecue sauce, about 30 to 40 minutes.
Place jars in boiling canner and process for 15 minutes.

ingredients.item: Grand Marnier or orange juice from concentrate

prep.step: Place apricots and water in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan. Cover and let stand for at least 4 hours or overnight
Add apple, lemon rind and lemon juice. Bring to a full boil over high heat, reduce heat, cover and boil gently for about 15 minutes or until fruit is tender, stirring occasionally.
Add sugar to saucepan. Return to a boil, reduce heat and boil gently, uncovered, until mixture will form a light gel (see note below), about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add liqueur (or juice) return to a boil and boil gently for 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in almonds

Ladle into sterlized jars. Place jars in canner and adjust water level to cover jars by 1 to 2 inches. Cover canner and return water to boil. Begin timing when water returns to a full boil. Process for 5 minutes.
Remove jars from canner to cooling rack and cool for 24 hours. Check jar seals (sealed lids turn downward). Label and store in a cool, dark place.

notes.title: Sheet or Spoon Gel Test
notes.content: Test for gel formation by periodically dipping a cool metal spoon into the hot fruit mixture and immediately lifting the spoon so the mixture runs off. At first the drops will be light and syrupy. As the mixture continues to cook, the drops from the spoon will become heavier. When the mixture "sheets" from the spoon (the drops become very thick and two drops run together before dropping off), it will form a gel on cooling and no further cooking is required.

prep.step: In a large bowl stir together the flour, baking powder and salt. In a small mixing bowl, beat the egg yolks and add the oil and milk. In a third bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff. Gently fold in the liquid ingredients to the dry, but DO NOT OVERMIX. Gently fold in egg whites, sliced apple and vanilla.
Spoon small portion onto waffle maker
Cook pasta in a large pot of salted water until el dente. Drain, reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water. Return pasta to pot, stir in half the butter and half to cheese.

While pasta is cooking, place a large skillet over medium heat and add 1/2 butter, onion and prosciutto. Saute gently without allowing it to colour, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium low, in stir in peas and season with salt and pepper.
Add reserved water to skillet to cook peas, simmer until ready. Add pasta and stir together.

ingredients.name: Topping
ingredients.item: butter, at room temperature, cut into pieces

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F (180C). Peel, core and slice apples into 1/4 inch thick pieces. You should have 7 to 8 cups. Slice cranberries in half. Stir sugar with flour, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl. Stir in apples, cranberries and vanilla until evenly coated. Turn into a square 8 inch baking dish. Gently press down fruit to level to top.

To make topping, mix oats with sugar and flour in a medium sized bowl. Add butter and work with a fork until clumpy. Stir in nuts. Sprinkle topping evenly over filling. Dish will be very full, but fruit filling will sink during baking. Bake until topping is golden brown and filling bubbles, about 40 to 45 minutes. If top becomes too brown before apple are tender, loosely lay a piece of foil over top of crisp and continue baking.

recipe.title: Slow Cook Beef and Barley Stew

prep.step: Place all ingredients in slow cooker and stir to combine. Cook, on low for 8-9 hours, on high for 4 hours. Add either cumin or chili powder to taste for extra zing.

Sprinkle all sides of park with salt and pepper. Cook in hot oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Transfer to 6-quart slow cooker and add garlic, bay leaves and onions. Whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce and vinegar until sugar dissolves; pour mixture over pork. Cover and cook on LOW 8 hours.
Transfer pork to serving platter, cover to keep warm. Pour cooking liquid through strainer into a medium saucepan, discard solids. Bring to boil over medium-high heat; boil 8 minutes.

Spoon 1/4 cup cooking liquid into a small bowl and whisk in flour and lemon juice until smooth. Return to heat and boil, whisking constantly, 1 to 2 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve over pork.

ingredients.item: large onion, thinly sliced (about a cup)

ingredients.name: AHA mix
ingredients.item: ground: basil, thyme, parsley, savory, mace, onion powder,pepper, sage

prep.step: In a large saucepan, add olive oil and saute onion and pepper until they are tender.

Add stock and carrots. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover pan and simmer for 5 minutes. Add potatoes, celery and salt. Simmer, covered for another 10 minutes or until the potatoes and carrots are tender.
Stir in turkey, corn, pimiento, thyme, herb mix, black pepper and milk. Heat chowder thoroughly, but do not let it come to a boil.
To make meatballs, combine ground beef, chickpeas, onion, garlic, egg white, breadcrumbs, cumin, salt and pepper. Shape mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls - you should have about 30.
Heat oil in large, deep skillet and brown meatballs on all sides. Remove from pan.
Discard all but 2 tsp. oil from pan. Add onions, garlic and hot pepper flakes. Cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in cumin and turmeric. Cook for 30 seconds.
Add pureed tomatoes and meatballs and bring to boil. Cook gently, covered, for 20 minutes. Cook uncovered for another 10 minutes. Add pepper and salt. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary.
Saute the pork and half the garlic in tablespoon oil in large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through. Place in bowl.

Wipe out skillet with paper towel. Heat remaining oil in skillet. Add scallions, carrots, slaw and remaining garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, 8 minutes or until softened. Add hoisin sauce and soy sauce; heat through, about 2 minutes. Add the pork; gently heat through.

Heat tortillas following the directions. Brush each with extra hoisin sauce. Spoon pork mixture down centre of each. Roll up; serve. A serving of each recipe constitutes an entire meal; you don't need side dishes.

recipe.title: Wilted Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Vinaigrette

prep.step: To make the vinaigrette: render the bacon. Remove the diced bacon from the pan and reserve. Add the shallots and garlic to the bacon fat and sweat. Blend in the brown sugar to melt. Whisk in the cider vinegar and the oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Add the spinach to the dressing; toss until just wilted. Transfer to a plate. Top with eggs, mushrooms, onion rings, croutons, and reserved bacon.
Combine flour, brown sugar and baking soda in large bowl. Combine egg, yogurt and oil in small bowl. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Stir in apples and cranberries.
Spray muffin pan, cups and top with canola oil. Fill muffin cups with batter. Sprinkle with topping. Bake at 375F (190C) for about 25 minutes, or until tops are firm to touch.
Melt butter in pan and saute onion and garlic. Add flour and cook another 2 minutes.
Gradually add milk and thicken with cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Mix macaroni with sauce and place in casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and bake in 350F oven, 10 minutes covered, 10 minutes uncovered.
Makes enough for 6 square trays, make enough topping for all trays.
Grate potatoes and onion in a food processor using the grating blade. Place in towel and wring out excess moisture.
Combine potato-onion mixture, egg, salt, pepper, flour and baking powder.

Heat a thin layer of oil in large skillet on medium heat. Place two tablespoons potato mixture into hot oil and flatten with a fork. The latkes will be irregularly shaped. Fry until well browned on both sides and crisp around the edges, about 3 minutes per side. Drain well on paper towels. Makes about 12 latkes.

recipe.title: Slow Cook Chicken with Lemon and Olives

prep.step: Place the potatoes and onions into a slow cooker and season with salt and pepper. Season the chicken generously. Heat the vegetable oil in large frying pan then fry the thighs until golden brown all over, about 5 minutes each side. Put the chicken on top of the vegetables.

Finely grate the zest of lemon, cut four thin slices of lemon, and then squeeze the juice into a small container. Add zest, garlic and ras el hanout to frying pan, fry for one minute till fragrant, and then pour in the lemon juice and stock. Bring to a boil, and then pour over chicken. Top with lemon slices, olives and one tablespoon olive oil from the jar, then cover with the lid and cook on low for 6 hours, until the chicken is very tender.

notes.title: If you can't find ras el hanout
notes.content: use: 1/2 tsp. ground ginger, 1/2 tsp. pepper, 1 tsp. ground coriander and 1 tsp. cinnamon

ingredients.item: diced pimento or roasted red peppers

prep.step: Heat oven to 350F. Heat margarine in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat. Cook leeks and onion about 7 minutes, stirring occasionally until softened.

Stir in flour, salt, nutmeg and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly; remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute.

Stir in turkey, ham and pimiento. Spread about half of the turkey mixture in ungreased square pan, 9 X 9 X 2 inches, or 2 1/2 quart casserole. Spread noodles over turkey mixture. Top with remaining turkey mixture. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until cheese is light brown.
Mix first four ingredients. Cut in lard until the size of small peas.
Beat egg in measuring cup, add vinegar and add water to make 1 cup.
Slowly pour water into dry mixture and, using your hands, mix until it comes together just enough to cling to your hands. You may not use all the liquids.
Roll immediately or cool in fridge until ready to use.
*depending on all purpose or pastry flour
Place Olive oil in a large frying pan, over medium heat. Add all the mushrooms and saute, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender.
Add chicken stock, garlic, parsley and cream (or yogurt). Simmer until the mixture has thickened and is reduced 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, and garnish with extra parsley.

ingredients.item: few springs or thyme and oregano
medium potatoes, cut into large pieces

prep.step: A day before serving, wash chicken, pat dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Place bird in bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight.

A couple of hours before dinner, remove chicken from refrigerator and allow to come to room temperature. Preheat oven to 400F. Place chicken in roasting pan, rub with olive oil, paprika and za'atar. Pierce lemon with sharp knife and place inside chicken with other herbs. Place in oven.

After about 20 minutes, remove chicken from oven, and transfer to a plate. Add potatoes, onions and garlic to roasting pan and toss to coat evenly in fat. Place chicken on top and cook approximately 40 minutes longer or until juices run clear. Allow chicken to rest for 10 to 20 minutes before serving with vegetables and roast garlic.

ingredients.item: boneless cross rib or blade roast

prep.step: In Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat; brown roast, turning with wooden spoons, about 10 minutes. Drain off any fat.
Combine onions, beef stock, sugar, vinegar, ginger, salt, pepper, cloves and bays leaf; pour over roast. Cover and cook in 350F (180C) oven for 3 hours.

Add potatoes; cook, covered, for 20 to 30 minutes or until potatoes and meat are tender. Discard bay leaf. Transfer meat to cutting board. With slotted spoon, transfer onions and potatoes to platter. Cover and keep warm.

SAUCE: In small bowl, whisk flour into sour cream; whisk in 1/2 cup of the pan juices. Whisk mixture back into pot. Add green pepper. Bring to boil over high heat; cook, stirring, for about minutes or until thickened. Slice beef; add to platter. Serve with sauce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

ingredients.item: green bell peppers cut into strips
red bell peppers cut into strips

prep.step: Fill boiling water canner with water. Place 8 clean pint (500 mL) mason jars in canner over high heat.
Make pickling liquid: combine vinegar, water, salt and sugar in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan. Bring to a boil; boil gently while packing jars.

Place Snap Lids in boiling water; boil 5 minutes to soften sealing compound. Pack a mixture of hot peppers with bell pepper strips snugly into a hot jar to within 3/4 inch (2 cm) of top rim. Add hot brine to cover peppers to within 1/2 inch (1 cm) of top rim (head space). Remove air bubbles by sliding a rubber spatula between glass and food; readjust head space to 1/2 inch (1 cm). Wipe jar rim removing any stickiness. Center Snap Lid on jar; apply screw band just until fingertip tight. Place jar in canner. Repeat for remaining peppers and brine.
The most common hot peppers available in today's markets include Hungarian, hot banana, chili and jalapeno peppers. Sweet bell peppers provide flavor balance.

ingredients.item: chuck roast cut into 2 inch cubes
medium red potatoes, cut into 2" pieces
whole tomatoes, canned and lightly crush
red wine vinegar, or to taste

prep.step: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Pour in enough oil to fill the pan about 1/4 inches deep. Season beef generously with salt and pepper, and add to pan. Saute the meat uncovered, stirring only occasionally, until well-browned, about 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate. Repeat with remaining beef. Discard the oil and wipe pan.

Preheat oven to 350F. Return the pot to the stove and melt the butter over medium high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until lightly browned. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until lightly brown, about 1 minute. Add beef and scatter the flour over the vegetables and beef mixture and cook stirring until lightly toasted. Add the water/stock and bring to a simmer. Tie the parsley, thyme and bay leaves together and add to the pot. Season with 2 tsp. salt or to taste. Cover and transfer to oven. Cook the meat until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

Remove pot from oven. Skim any fat from the top. Add the potatoes, carrots, parsnips, celery, mushrooms and tomatoes, and bring to simmer on top of stove. Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the liquid thickens and the vegetables are tender, about an hour. Remove herb bundle, stir in vinegar and, if necessary, top up seasoning of salt and pepper. Serve with crusty bread of your choice.

ingredients.item: chopped fresh thyme or 1 tsp. dried

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F.
Cut deep slits in the pork loin with the tip of a small sharp knife and insert the garlic slivers. Place the pork in a shallow roasting pan. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, mustard, thyme, and pepper. Spread this evenly over the pork.
Heat the chicken broth, wine, and jam together in a small pan until the jelly dissolves and pour this over the pork.

Roast the pork on the centre rack of the oven until cooked through (150 to 160F on a meat thermometer), about 1 1/2 hours or 20 minutes per pound; baste frequently and add in a bit more wine if necessary. Let the pork rest for 15 minutes before slicing.
In large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tbsp. vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Brown meat.
Add all ingredients into slow cooker. Cover and cook low for 8 to 10 hours.
Stir in red pepper just before serving.

In a large saucepan over medium heat melt butter and oil. Add onions, garlic and sugar. Saute until slightly colored, stirring occasionally (not too much - you want them to brown), for about 7 minutes.
Add the wine, raise temperature to medium high and bring to boil.
Lower temperature back down to medium and cook from 5 minutes.
Add stock, raise temperature to medium high and bring to simmer.
Lower temperature to low and simmer "uncovered" for 1 1/2 hours.

notes.title: To Serve
notes.content: Ladle soup into ovenproof bowls, place two slices to toasted baguette on top. Preheat broiler, sprinkle each serving with ? cup grated cheese and 1/3 tsp. Parmesan cheese. Place soup bowls onto a baking sheet and place under broiler. Broil until cheese melts, it can take anywhere from 45 to 90 seconds.

prep.step: Trim fat and discard skin from ham hock, set aside.
In large Dutch Oven melt butter over medium heat add carrots, celery, onion and garlic, cook until very soft, about 15 minutes

Add peas, bay leaves, savory, thyme, salt and pepper, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add 8 cups water (or stock) and ham hock bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until peas are very soft and soup has thickened, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Discard bay leaves. Transfer ham hock to plate; let cool enough to handle, Discard bone and any fat, dice meat and return to soup; heat through.

ingredients.item: green or red chili, sliced into thin rings

prep.step: Heat 2 tbsp. oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and ginger, and saute until translucent.

Add coconut milk and simmer until reduced by half, 3 to 4 minutes. Add shrimp and chili pepper and simmer, stirring occasionally, until shrimp is fully cooked, about 4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients.item: white chocolate or 1 package semi-sweet chocolate chunks

prep.step: Cream margarine and sugars together.
Cream after adding each of the following: egg, water, vanilla, flour, baking soda, and cinnamon.
Add oats and mix well.
Add coconut and mix well.
Add Chocolate and mix well.
Drop dough by ice-cream scoop onto baking sheet. Press flat for crisp cookies. Leave mounded for chewy cookies.
Bake at 350F (180C) for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are golden brown.

ingredients.item: red bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped

prep.step: Rinse the chicken well, removing any excess fat and pat dry.
Heat oil in large heavy pot over low heat. Add onions and cook, stirring until wilted, 10 to 15 minutes. Do not brown. Sprinkle with the paprika and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.

Add the chicken, tomatoes, bell pepper, and broth. Season with salt and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low, and simmer covered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not let the sauce boil.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the yogurt and flour together in a small bowl. Set aside.

When the chicken has cooked for 30 minutes, remove the pieces to a bowl. Cook the sauce uncovered over medium heat for 10 minutes to reduce it slightly. Pour 1/4 cup of the hot sauce into the yogurt and whisk until smooth. Gradually add the yogurt to the rest of the sauce, while whisking until smooth. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
Return the chicken pieces to the pot and cover them well with the sauce. Heat through gently over low heat. Do not let the sauce to boil. Serve immediately over egg noodles.

recipe.title: Chicken Singapore Style

ingredients.name: Marinade
ingredients.item: small dried chili, finely crumbled or chili paste

ingredients.name: Peanut Sauce
ingredients.item: chili paste or 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes

recipe.prep: Heat oil in a large skillet over low heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 5 minutes. Add the curry powder and chili paste; cook 2 to 3 minutes to mellow the flavors. Stir in the coconut milk and water, and then stir in the peanut butter, lemon juice, vinegar, brown sugar, cinnamon stick, and bay leaf. Mix well together. Bring the mixture to a boil and immediately reduce the heat to low. Simmer gently, stirring, until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Stir in the chopped peanuts if using. Remove the cinnamon stick and bay leaf. Place the mixture in a food processor and process until smooth. Scrape the sauce into a serving bowl and cool to room temperature. Store covered in the refrigerator. Let warm to room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before serving. If the peanut sauce separates a bit before serving, whisk in a few drops, up to 1 tsp, of boiling water, and the sauce will come together.

notes.title: To use Marinade
notes.content: Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover chicken well with marinade and let rest covered at room temperature for 2 hours or refridgerate over night to intensify flavour.

prep.step: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shallots; cook and stir until starting to brown. Reduce heat to medium and add mushrooms, thyme, garlic and chives; continue to cook until the liquid has evaporated, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
In a medium bowl, stir together the mascarpone cheese and mushroom mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper; set aside.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the ravioli one at a time and cook until they float to the top, 3 to 4 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350F.
In a large bowl, cream together sugars and butter. Mix in eggs, vanilla and milk.
Stir in flour, baking powder and soda and salt until well combined.
Stir in oats and raisins or chips.
Bake in 10 ?12 minutes or until golden brown.
In a heavy saucepan combine the pepper, onion, cider vinegar, sugar, mustard seed, salt and red pepper flakes.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour, or until reduced to about 3 cups. Relish will keep covered in refrigerator for about 1 month.

recipe.title: Chicken Parmigiana Casserole with Fresh Basil

prep.step: To make sauce: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and garlic. Saute 2 or 3 minutes or until fragrant. Add red pepper, carrot and tomatoes, including juice. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Partially cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in sugar, basil and black pepper. Sauce can be made ahead and refrigerated for 2 or 3 days.

Remove fillets from chicken breasts. Place each piece of chicken, including fillets, between pieces of plastic wrap or inside a heavy plastic bag. Flatten to 1/2 inch thick using a flat mallet or bottom of saucepan. Heat 1 tbsp. olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Stir flour with salt. Lightly four 3 to 4 pieces of chicken at a time. Saute 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Chicken may not be fully cooked. Remove and repeat with remaining chicken adding more oil as needed. Spoon some of the tomato sauce into hot frying pan to deglaze. Stir back into sauce in pot.
Stir garlic with 2 tbsp. olive oil in a small bowl. Add bread crumbs, half of grated Parmesan and chopped basil. Toss crumbs until coated.

Preheat oven to 350F. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish or coat with cooking spray. Spread 1 cup of sauce in bottom. Arrange chicken in a single layer, overlapping pieces as needed. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan and provolone cheeses. Spoon another cup of sauce over top. Sprinkle evenly with crumbs. You may refrigerate covered casserole and remaining sauce for several hours if made ahead.

Bake uncovered in centre of oven for 40 to 45 minutes (10 minutes longer if casserole has been refrigerated) or until bubbly and top is golden brown. Reheat remaining sauce. Place a small amount of sauce on warmed serving plate. Top with a portion of casserole.
Serve on broad egg noodles

ingredients.name: Fries
ingredients.item: Sea or Kosher salt to taste

ingredients.name: Batter
ingredients.item: fresh white fish, cut into strips

prep.step: Heat oven to 200F.
Heat safflower oil in a 5 quart Dutch oven over high heat until it reaches 320F.
Slice potatoes with skin on. Place in a large bowl with cold water.

In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, cayenne pepper. Whisk in the beer until the batter is completely smooth and free of any lumps. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Note: The batter can be made up to 1 hour ahead of time.

Drain potatoes thoroughly, removing any excess water. When oil reaches 320F, submerge the potatoes in the oil. Working in small batches, fry for 2 or 3 minutes until they are pale and floppy. Remove from oil, drain, and cool to room temperature.

Increase the temperature of the oil to 375F. Re-immerse fries and cook until crisp and golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove and drain on roasting rack. Season with kosher salt while hot and hold in the oven.

Allow oil to return to 350F. Lightly dredge fish strips in cornstarch. Working in small batches, dip the fish into batter and immerse into hot oil. When the batter is set, turn the pieces of fish over and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Drain fish on the roasting rack. Serve with malt vinegar.

recipe.title: Cream of Tomato and Roasted Red Pepper Soup

ingredients.item: heavy cream, heated almost to boil

prep.step: Cook the tomatoes, broth and seasoning in a covered saucepan for 30 minutes over low heat.
Blend the butter and flour together with a fork until a smooth paste. Stir it along with the sugar into the tomato mixture and cook over medium heat until slightly thicken.
Add heated cream to the tomato mixture very slowly, return to the heat and bring the soup very slowly almost to a boil.
Puree with immersion blender until smooth.
Put all ingredients in a casserole dish. Mix and simmer until water has evaporated. Let cool, place in container.
Cover and cook for about 2 hour.
Bring 1 cup of water to the boil, add rice, reduce heat to simmer cook until rice adsorbs all the water and light and fluffy. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 350F. Clean out peppers to make room for stuffing. If peppers do not stand up straight, slice a little off the bottom to level out.
In a large saucepan cook peppers in boiling wate until crisp-tender (about 4 to 5 minutes). Rinse in cool water, set aside.

In a large frying pan, heat oil on medium heat, brown meat; add garlic, onion, carrot and saute until tender. Add tomatoes, brown sugar, basil and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until much of liquid is adsorbed (20 minutes).
Place peppers in baking dish and stuff with meat mixture. Top with shredded cheese and bake in oven approximately 15 minutes. Served with heated tomato sauce.

ingredients.item: chopped fresh thyme or 1 tbsp. dried
cans, peeled whole tomato, crushed by hand reserve juices

prep.step: In a 3-quart saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until soft and lightly golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add the thyme and carrot and cook 5 minutes more, until the carrot is quite soft.
Add the tomatoes and juice and bring to boil, stirring often. Lower the heat and simmer for at least 30 minutes or until thick as hot cereal.
Season with salt and pepper and serve. Sauce holds 1 week in fridge or up to 6 months in the freezer.

ingredients.item: large onion, halved and thinly sliced

prep.step: Combine the soy sauce, garlic powder, curry powder, ginger, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Rub the roast all over with the spice mixture.

Put 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet and cook the onions over medium-high heat until lightly browned and softened. Remove and set aside. Sear the roast in the pan on all sides. Put the pork in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker along with the onions. Cover and cook on LOW for about 8 hours, until very tender.

Preheat the oven to 350F. Lightly oil a 13 by 9-inch rectangular baking dish. In a large saute pan, heat the olive oil. When the oil is hot, saute the onions and prosciutto for about 4 minutes or until the onions are wilted and slightly caramelized.

Stir in the 1/2 cup parsley, shallots and mushrooms. Saute for 10 minutes or until the mushrooms are golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the garlic, basil and oregano. Strain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid. Place the liquid back into the pan and reduce until the liquid forms a glaze, about 5 minutes. Scraping the sides occasionally to loosen any particles. Add the wine and follow the same process.

Add the tomatoes and continue to cook for 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add the mushroom mixture to the sauce. In a mixing bowl, combine the Ricotta cheese, egg, remaining parsley, 1/2 cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, and Mozzarella cheese. Season with salt and pepper.

To assemble, spoon a small amount of the sauce on the bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place a layer of the pasta on top of the sauce. Spread the cheese over the pasta. Repeat layering until all the ingredients are used. Mix the cream with any remaining cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Pour over the top of the lasagna. Cover the lasagna.
Bake for 30 minutes covered and 10 to 15 minutes uncovered, or until the lasagna is golden brown and set. Remove the lasagna from the oven and allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

ingredients.item: broiler or fryer chicken, cut into 8 pieces

prep.step: Place chicken pieces into a plastic container and cover with buttermilk. Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours.

Melt enough shortening (over low heat) to come just 1/8-inch up the side of a 12-inch cast iron skillet or heavy fry pan. Once shortening liquefies raise heat to 325F. Do not allow oil to go over 325F.
Drain chicken in a colander. Combine salt, paprika, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper. Liberally season chicken with this mixture. Dredge chicken in flour and shake off excess.

Place chicken skin side down into the pan. Put thighs in the center, and breast and legs around the edge of the pan. The oil should come half way up the pan. Cook chicken until golden brown on each side, approximately 10 to 12 minutes per side. More importantly, the internal temperature should be right around 180F. (Be careful to monitor shortening temperature every few minutes).

Drain chicken on a rack over a sheet pan. Don't drain by setting chicken directly on paper towels or brown paper bags. If you need to hold the chicken before serving, cover loosely with foil but avoid holding in a warm oven, especially if it's a gas oven.

recipe.title: Roasted Red Pepper and Goat Cheese Dip

prep.step: Preheat oven to 400F. Place peppers on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Roast for 20 minutes, turning occasionally, or until skin is charred and blistered. Remove the peppers from the oven and place in a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let sit for 20 minutes. Peel the peppers and remove the stems and seeds.

Place the peppers in a food processor and puree until smooth. Add garlic, goat cheese, lemon juice and sour cream to the peppers and puree until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Remove the mixture from the food processor and mix in the oregano. Refrigerate until ready to use. Serve the dip with the vegetables.

Preheat oven to 425F. Sift the flour, salt, baking powder and cream of tartar in to large bowl. Work in butter and shortening until mixture is the texture of wet sand. Add the buttermilk all at once and mix briefly.
Roll out dough to 1 inch thickness. Cut out scones with floured 2 1/2 -inch cutter. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet, brush tops with egg wash and bake for 10 minutes or until golden.

Wash six 1/2 cup canning jars. Fill boiling water canner two-thirds full of water. About 30 minutes before filling jars, start to heat. Ten minutes before filling jars, place jars and metal funnel on canner rack, bring to boil.
About 10 minutes before filling jars, heat small saucepan of water until hot but not boiling; add lids and let stand to soften sealing compound.
In large saucepan, bring sweet peppers, hot peppers, hot pepper sauce, sugar and vinegar to full rolling boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Boil to five (5) minutes.

Stir in liquid pectin. Remove from heat and skim off foam. Using a funnel and measure, fill jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace. If necessary wipe rims with damp paper towel. Centre lids on jars; screw on bands finger tight.
Place jars in canner, bring to boil for 10 minutes. Turn off heat. Let water stop boiling before removing jars. Let set for 24 hours.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: To increase "heat" allow chopped peppers to meld in vinegar 15 - 30 minutes before starting cooking process.

ingredients.item: hickory smoked salt or kosher salt

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F. Peel off tough membrane that covers the bony side of the ribs.
Mix together the sugar and spices to make a rub. Apply rub to ribs on all sides.

Lay ribs on two layers of foil, shiny side out. Lay second double layer on top of ribs and crimp edges to seal ribs inside package. Place on baking sheet and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is starting to shrink away from the ends of the bone.
Remove from oven. Cut ribs into serving sized portions of 2 to 3 ribs. Place on broiler pan, bony side up and brush on BBQ Sauce. Broil for 1 or minutes until sauce is cooked on and bubbly.
Turn ribs over and repeat 4.
Alternately, you can grill the ribs on your grill to cook on the sauce.

Finely chop the onion, leek, carrot and celery. Heat the oil/butter in pan, add finely chopped vegetables and let sweat and soften in fat. Add the lentils and stir, and then add stock. Bring to boil and simmer until lentils are soft (approximately 40 minutes). Add cooked chestnuts and simmer for another 20. Using an immersion blender, blend until smooth, adding water as you need.

TO COOK CHESTNUTS: Cut small X in rounded top of chestnut and place on cookie pan in 375 F for between 35 and 40 minutes. Chestnuts are ready when skins are turning a little brown and are popping open at slit. Remove from pan to a towel lined bowl and cover with towel and allow them to stand about 15 minutes. When cool, peel outer skin as well as the thin inner skin.

recipe.title: Strubs Family Home Style Brine Recipe

ingredients.item: fresh pickling cucumbers (length to diameter ratio 3:1)

prep.step: Add salt, vinegar to water. Mix until the salt is dissolved.
Prick the skin of each cucumber once or twice lightly with a fork to allow the flavours to penetrate the cucumbers.
Peeled and chopped garlic.
Add dill.
(Add 1/4 cup sliced Hot Banana Peppers) optional.
Pack cucumbers tightly into the jar. (whole or sliced).
Add brine mixture to jars and fill to 1/4 inch from the rim of the jar.
Close cap tightly and place jars upright into the pot.

Fill pot with tap water to cover bottles and bring to a slow boil. Continue boiling for 5 minutes then remove pot from burner. Begin adding tap water slowly so the pot overflows slowly. Adding water too quickly may crack the jars! Continue until the jars are cool enough to hold against your face.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: Experiment with flavours: try adding extra garlic, green peppercorns or whole chilies

prep.step: Blend all dry ingredients, mix well.
Add water and cook until thick then add lemon juice.
Pack apples in quart jars and pour cooked filling over the apples.
Put lids in quart jars and pour cooked filling over apples. Place in large pot.
After 20 minutes, take each jar out carefully and put on towel, use pot holder to tighten rings on each jar and let stand until cool.
Mark date on outside of jar and store for future use.

recipe.title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Mushroom Stew

ingredients.item: flour for thickening, more is needed

prep.step: Add oil to a medium-high heavy skillet. Patiently brown the chicken thighs, turning until they're thoroughly golden brown and delicious, 10 minutes or so. Place in slow cooker. Dissolve any and all browned bits remaining in the pan with a slash of water and add to works.
Wash the mushrooms in lots of cool water.
Prep the mushrooms. Leave small ones whole, larger ones can be halved, quartered or sliced.
Pile the mushrooms, onions/leeks and garlic on top of the chicken. Pour in sherry, broth, flour and season with salt, pepper and bay leaf.
Set slow cooker for 6 to 8 hours.
Carefully fish out the meat. Ease out and remove any bones. Reserve the meat for a moment. First stir the thyme, spinach and cream in the stew then return the chicken.

notes.title: How to Twist
notes.content: Try serving over mashed potatoes, any rice, grain or legume, your favourite pasta or steaming noodles.

prep.step: Cream sugar and margarine/butter. Beat egg and yogurt, beat in milk. Mix flour and baking powder, add to egg mixture until blended. Stir in lemon rind. Bake in 350F oven for 1 hour.
When cool, mix lemon juice and sugar and pour over warm cake.

ingredients.item: tortillas, warmed and cut in half

prep.step: In large nonstick skillet, heat 2 tsp. of oil vegetable oil over medium heat; stir fry ground beef. Remove from skillet and drain any fat.
Add red onion, red pepper, corn and garlic, (salt and pepper to taste and more vegetable oil) to skillet; stir fry until softened.
Add barbecue sauce, jalapeno and chili powder to vegetables and stir for another two minutes.
Return meat and any accumulated juices to skillet, cook from 1 minute.
Add 1/2 cup of mixture to warmed tortillas.

ingredients.name: For Filling
ingredients.item: fresh or frozen corn and peas

prep.step: Peel the potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Place in medium saucepan and cover with cold water. Set over high heat, cover and bring to boil. Once boiling, uncover and decrease temperature to simmer and cook until tender, about 10 to 5 minutes.

Place half and half and butter in microwave and heat until warmed through. Drain potatoes, return to saucepan. Mash and add half and half, butter, salt and pepper and continue until smooth. Stir in egg yolk until well combined.
Preheat oven to 400F.

Prepare filling: Place oil in saute pan and set over medium high heat. Add onion and saute just until they begin to take on colour. Add garlic and carrots stir to combine. Add meat, salt and pepper and cook until browned. Sprinkle meat with flour and toss to coat, continuing to cook for another minute. Add tomato paste, stock, Worcestershire sauce, rosemary, thyme and store to combine. Bring to boil, reduce heat to low and cover, simmer slowly until sauce thickens slightly.
Add corn and peas to mixture and spread evenly into 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Top with mashed potatoes, seal edges.
Place on lined baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes or until potatoes just start to brown. Remove allow to cool for at least 15 minutes.
In a large soup pot, melt the butter. Saute the leeks, carrot and onion for 2 minutes. Add the wine and simmer another 2 minutes.
Add the chicken, basil, thyme, salt, pepper and stock. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

recipe.title: Chicken Soup with Lemon and Spinach

prep.step: In large saucepan, over medium high heat; fry onion, garlic, carrot, celery, pepper, cumin and pepper. Stir often until all vegetable are softened.
Pour in stock and bring to boil, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender. Stir in spinach, chicken, rind and juice. Simmer until pasta is cooked.

recipe.title: Cream of Mushroom and Leek Soup

prep.step: In a large pot, saute garlic with olive oil over low heat for about 3-5 minutes. Add onions, leeks and shallots. Turn up the heat to medium and saute until wilted. Add thyme. Saute for another 5 minutes.

Next, saute all the mushrooms in the same pot. Add more olive oil if necessary. Season with salt and pepper. Once the mushrooms are tender, add the chicken broth, white wine and cream. Mix thoroughly. When the mixture comes to a boil, turn down the heat to simmer.
While the pot is simmering, use your hand blender to puree the mixture. Ladle soup into individual bowls and garnish with sliced mushrooms, a slice of crostini and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe.title: Slow Cook Beef Stew - Pepper Pot

ingredients.item: each red and green bell pepper

prep.step: Trim fat from beef, coat using 3 tbsp. of all-purpose flour.
In large skillet heat 1 tbsp. of vegetables oil over medium high heat, brown beef in batches. Transfer to slow cooker.
Return to skillet and add 1/2 cup water and boil. Scraping up any brown bits; add to cooker.

Add bacon, onion, celery, sweet potatoes, garlic, beef stock and all dry spices, stir well to combine. Cover and cook on Low for 8 to 10 hours (on High 4 to 6 hours), or until meat and vegetables are tender.
Whisk together 1/4 cup of water and all purpose flour (more if required); add to cooker along with green and red pepper, wine vinegar and hot pepper sauce. Cook covered on High for 20 minutes.

recipe.title: Slow Cook Beef Stew - Spanish Beef with Vegetables

ingredients.item: each dried thyme, sage, salt & pepper

prep.step: Trim fat from beef, coat using 3 tbsp. of all-purpose flour.
In large skillet heat 1 tbsp. of vegetables oil over medium high heat, brown beef in batches. Transfer to slow cooker.
Return to skillet and add 1/2 cup water and boil. Scraping up any brown bits; add to cooker.

Add onions, potatoes, carrots, parsnip, garlic, beef stock and all dry spices, stir well to combine. Cover and cook on Low for 8 to 10 hours (on High 4 to 6 hours), or until meat and vegetables are tender.
Whisk together 1/3 cup of water and all purpose flour, add to cooker. Cook covered on High for 20 minutes.
Combine over ice, stir. Garnish with lemon twist

notes.title: Modification
notes.content: Can replace Lillet with Cocchi Americano Aperitivo Rosa

ingredients.item: honeydew melon, seeded and cut into 1 inch cubes
each sliced and seeded lime and star fruit
pink grapefruit, seeded, sliced and quarted

prep.step: In a pitcher, combine grapes, kiwi, watermelon, honeydew, lime, star fruit and grapefruit. Sprinkle with superfine sugar and stir to combine. Add Cointreau and brandy and let stand for at least an hour.
After resting, add white wine and cranberry juice. Add more sugar if desired.

ingredients.item: poppy seeds, plus more for sprinkling

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F. Bring lemon juice to a simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat; cook until reduced by half. Add 1 butter stick; stir until melted.

Whisk together flour, baking powder and salt. Cream remaining stick butter and 1 cup sugar on medium speed in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Mix in egg and lemon butter. Mix until pale, about 3 minutes. Mix in vanilla and 2 tsp. zest. Mix in flour mixture and poppy seeds.

Stir together remaining 1/2 cup sugar and 1 1/2 tsp. zest. Roll spoonfuls of dough into 1 1/4-inch balls; roll them in sugar mixture. Place 2 inches apart on baking sheets. Press each with the flat end of a glass dipped in sugar mixture until 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle with seeds.
Bake until just browned around bottom edges, 10 to 11 minutes. Transfer to wire racks; let cool completely. Store in an airtight container up to 1 week.
Place the egg yolk, mustard, anchovies, garlic, vinegar, lemon juice and dash of Worcestershire sauce in a blender. Blend until purreed.

With motor running, add the olive oil in a slow, steady stream until it is fully incorporated. If the dressing stops moving in the blender, stop the machine, add the water and then continue until all the oil is added.
To finish, add the cheese and blend on low speed to incorporate.
Put whole romaine leaves in a work bowl. Add enough of the dressing to coat the leaves and toss well. Add croutons and toss again to combine. Sprinkle the Parmesan and serve.

In a large frying pan over medium heat, saute onion, ground beef, garlic and chili powder until beef is slightly cooked. Add the remaining ingredients; reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat.
Can be served over spaghetti and topped with shredded cheddar cheese, onions or kidney beans, or all three.
Melt 1 tbsp. of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Add vanilla and saute apple until lightly golden. Remove from heat and set aside.
Lower heat to medium-low and add remaining butter. Add onions, stirring well to coat. Allow onions to sweat in the pan, about 15 minutes or until soft.
Increase heat to allow any excess liquid to evaporate. Stir in vinegar and sauteed apple. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and keep warm.
In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat; fry onion, garlic, celery, potato, herb seasoning, salt and pepper, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add stock and lentils; bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Using a potato masher, mash soup until slightly thickened but still chunky. Add carrots, peas, corn and tomato paste, simmer, covered, until carrots are tender, about 10 minutes.

ingredients.item: green bell peppers cut into 1/2 inch pieces
medium carrots, cut into 1 inch pieces
medium zucchini, cut into 1 inch cubes
canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

prep.step: Saute onions, pepper, garlic and jalapeno in oil in 8 quart heavy pot over moderately high heat, stirring until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt and pepper, cook, stirring, about 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, carrots and zucchini and simmer, partially covered, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.
Stir in corn, kidney beans and chocolate and simmer, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes, stir in parsley.
Combine sugar, cocoa, butter and milk is saucepan. Stir in vanilla. Remove from heat and stir in coconut and rolled oats.
Drop by spoonful onto wax paper and chill in refrigerator.
Combine water, coconut milk, jalapeno, thyme and rice in pot. Bring to boil, cover, turn heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Add beans, cover and cook 10 minutes more or until rice cooked. Remove from heat and let steam, covered for 5 minutes.

Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add leeks and saute for 2 minutes or until softened. Add mushrooms and saute until; juices start to appear. Add spinach, stir together, and cook until spinach wilts. Season with salt and pepper. Drain off any juice and add it to the cream. Reserve vegetables.

Brush a large ovenproof baking dish with butter. Place a layer of bread on base. Brush with butter. Place half of vegetable mixture over bread. Add a second layer of bread and brush with butter. Add remaining vegetables.
Whisk together eggs, cream, chives and hot-pepper sauce and season well with salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables. Let sit one hour or overnight refrigerated.
Sprinkle top with paprika and bake in 350F oven for 45 minutes or until puffed.
Spoon 1/2 tsp. of raspberry jam in bottom of tart shells.
Beat eggs, stir in combined sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add cooled melted butter, lemon juice and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in coconut and fill rest of tart shells with mixture.
Bake at 375F for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden on top. Cool for at least 10 minutes.
Mix together liquid ingredients and add to dry ingredients.
Bake at 350F for 40 to 60 minutes.
Add sugar gradually to shorting. Add eggs one at a time; whip until fluffy after each egg.
Make a paste of cocoa and red colouring and salt, add to mixture.
Sift cake flour add vanilla and butter milk. Dissolve baking soda in vinegar, then add all ingredients together.
Bake at 350F for 35 to 40 minutes.
Pour milk over oats. Cover and let stand overnight.
Mix together carrots, sugars, egg and orange rind.
Mix remaining dry ingredients (flour, baking soda/powder and salt). Pour in liquids.
Bake at 400F for 20 to 25 minutes.
In a small bowl combine paprika, garlic salt and olive oil into paste.
Use a mallet to gently pound chicken breasts until they are an even thickness, about 1 1/2 times the original size.
Spread a thin even layer of mixture on both sides and let stand for 20 minutes to allow the flavours to infuse the meat.
Place 4 inches under broiler cook for about 7 minutes until a crust begins to form. Flip, if breasts appear a little dry after you turn them, baste with a little olive oil. Cook another 7 minutes.
Let breasts rest of a couple of minutes, serve with salad.
Combine flour and milk, cook to thick paste, cover and allow to cool.
Beat shorting, butter, sugar and salt until creamy.
Add cooled paste, vanilla and almond extract; combine in stand mixer until smooth (10 to 15 minutes).

ingredients.item: chunk roast, cut into 1 inch cubes

prep.step: In cast iron skillet add bacon and cook until fat has rendered and bacon is golden and crispy. Remove from heat, transfer bacon to plate lined with paper towel. Pour off all but 1 tbsp. fat.

Return skillet to heat, sprinkle beef cubes with salt and pepper. When bacon fat is shimmering in pan, add a single layer of cubes to pan to seer. Let beef seer without moving until it releases easily from pan and underside is golden brown. Add another tbsp. of oil and repeat until all cubes are seared. Add 1/4 cup of wine to deglaze pan, scrape the dark glaze and any crispy bits into slow cooker.

Add another tbsp. of bacon fat to pan, reduce heat to medium and cook onions with 1/2 tsp. of salt until soft and browned. Add carrots and celery and cook until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook until fragrant. Transfer to slow cooker.

Wipe skillet clean and warm 1 tbsp. of leftover bacon fat (use vegetable oil if no more bacon fat) and cook mushrooms with 1/4 tsp. of salt until they release all their liquid, liquid has evaporated and mushrooms are golden brown. Set aside with cooked bacon.

Stir seared meat into slow cooker with vegetables add 1 tsp. of salt. Tuck sprigs of thyme and bay leaf in the mixture. Pour the stock and remaining wine over mixture: liquid should come about 1/2 of the way to the surface. Cover and cook 6 to 8 hours.
Once meat is cook, stir in the reserved bacon and mushrooms. Cook on high for about 10 minutes.

ingredients.item: cup honey (or 1 cup each brown/white sugar)

prep.step: Combine liquid ingredients into dry and bake in 9x12 inch pan (or bunt pan) or 24 3 oz Cup Cakes pan and cook at 350F for 25 minutes.

ingredients.item: whole unsalted almonds, toasted and finely ground

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F. Line bottom of each tart shell with dried beans or pie weights. Bake until pastry has dried slightly and has a sandy texture, about 15 minutes. Let cool on wire racks.

Meanwhile, put eggs and sugar into the bowl of an electric stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment. Beat on medium speed until pale and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Using a rubber spatula, fold in flour, ground almonds and salt.

Spread about 1 1/2 tsp. jam into each tart shell. Add blueberries, dividing evenly. Press lightly with a fork. Top each with 2 tbsp. batter. Sprinkle with sugar and almonds. Bake until tops have risen and are golden brown, 16 to 18 minutes. Let cool completely. Tartlets can be stored in airtight containers up to 1 day.

ingredients.item: Diana Sauce, Original Flavour (or your choice)
cooked penne or other short pasta

prep.step: Grill the sausages for 10 minutes, turning as needed, until browned all over and cooked through. Cool slightly and slice into bite-size pieces. Meanwhile, grill pepper until tender and skin is charred. Cool slightly, peel away and discard skin; slice the peppers into bite-size strips.
Stir together sauce and pesto, add oregano in large saucepan. Add pepper and sausage. Pour over cooked pasta.
Heat oil in skillet and saute sausages until brown and cooked. Remove from pan and slice.
Add celery and shallots to skillet; saute until soft. Stir in pancetta, garlic and parsley and continue cooking until bacon is crisp.
Add wine and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add salt and pepper (to taste) and cook for 10 minutes.
While sauce simmers, cook penne. Drain cooked pasta and toss with sauce. Top each serving of pasta with slice sausages and grated Parmigiano cheese and (optional) basil.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour or (1 cup flour and 3/4 cup of soft whole wheat flour)
each salt, ground cinnamon and ground ginger (or allspice)

prep.step: In a large bowl combine eggs, oil, buttermilk vanilla and pumpkin.
Mix well.
Add oatmeal.
In small dry skillet over high heat, toast millet until lightly brown and fragrant (about 3 minutes).
Add 2 tbsp. of seeds.
Add to egg mixture.
Into a medium bowl sift flours, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg.
Add to egg mixture and stir gently to combine. (DO NOT OVER MIX!).
Generously fill greased 12 cup non-stick muffin tins with batter. Muffin will have large tops when baked!
Sprinkle top with remaining seeds.
Bake in preheated oven at 350F for 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out cleanly. Set on wire rack to cool.
Makes 12.

Preheat oven to 350F. Place raisins in a small bowl. Pour juice overtop. Microwave, covered, until hot, 1 minute. Set aside. Lightly coat or spray a 12 cup muffin tin or 9x5 inch loaf pan with oil. In a large bowl, using a fork, stir flour with sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, allspice, mace, salt and cloves. Stir in raisin mixture, candied peel and apricots.

In a medium-size bowl, whisk egg. Whisk in milk, oil, butter and vanilla. Pour over flour mixture. Stir just until mixed. Batter will be lumpy. Divide between muffin cups or scrape into loaf pan and smooth top.

Bake in centre of preheated oven until cake tester inserted into centre of muffins or loaf comes out clean, 20 to 30 minutes for muffins or 1 hour for a loaf. Remove pan to cooling rack. After 5 minutes, remove from pan and cool completely on rack. Store muffins or loaf in an airtight container and store at room temperature up to 3 days or freeze up to 2 months.

notes.title: Great Glaze
notes.content: Stir 1 1/4 cups sifted icing sugar with 4 tsps. orange juice until smooth. Drizzle over cooked muffins in a crisscross pattern to mimic hot cross buns or spoon over loaf.

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

prep.step: Cut chicken breasts into 2-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Mix together coriander, cumin, turmeric, cloves and cayenne in a bowl. Reserve.

Heat oil and butter in a large saute pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sear, about 4 minutes. Remove from skillet. Add onion, season with salt and saute for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until onions are very soft.
Add ginger and garlic to pan, saute 3 minutes, add spice mixture and meld for 2 minutes.

Stir in tomatoes and stock and bring to boil. Simmer for 5 minutes or until flavours come together. Return chicken and cook, covered, over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove lid and cook 5 minutes longer or until chicken is just cooked through. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt.
To temper onions, heat oil in a small skillet over high heat. Add onions and saute, stirring, for 6 minutes or until dark brown and slightly crisp. Add mustard seeds and fry until you hear them pop.
Place the shrimp in a large bowl and add the lime juice. Measure in the ketchup, hot sauce, Worcestershire, onion and cilantro. Mix well.

Cut the avocado in half, running a knife around the pit from stem to blossom end and back again. Twist and scoop out the pit. Scoop each half out on to a cutting board, cut gently into small cubes and then scoop the avocado on top of the shrimp mixture. Carefully fold in the avocado, then divide the mixture between 4 to 6b serving dishes (martini glasses make a dressy presentation).
Trim and cut spareribs into racks of three. Place in a roasting pan and season with salt and pepper.

Combine honey, sherry (if used), vinegar, garlic, ginger, sugar, hoisin, soy and chili sauce and pour over ribs. Marinate for 1 hour at room temperature or up to 8 hours in the refrigerator, turning occasionally.
Preheat oven to 375F.

Stir stock into marinade. Cover roasting pan tightly with foil and bake ribs for 45 minutes. Uncover, turn ribs and bake 30 minutes more or until ribs are tender and glazed with sauce. If marinade in pan becomes too dry, add more stock/water. The sauce should be thick but spoon able.

ingredients.item: sea salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste

prep.step: Combine brown sugar, garlic, ginger and chili flakes in a bowl and rub mixture into flank steak. Place in large zip lock bag, pour in soy sauce, mirin and sesame seed oil, seal and marinade in fridge or 6-8 hours (overnight is best).
Remove steak from fridge 1 hour before cooking, the steak should be grilled at room temperature to ensure it's evenly cooked and tender.
Ten minutes before cooking, remove from marinate and sprinkle sea salt and pepper on both sides.

notes.title: BBQ Method
notes.content: Turn on BBQ to high heat, close lid and allow it to heat up. The BBQ should be 500 - 600F before grilling the steak.
Place steak over flame, close lid and do not touch.
After 3 1/2 minutes, flip steak and close lid again.
Wait another 3 1/2 minutes and remove steak from BBQ. Place steak on a plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil and let rest for at least 5 minutes.
Slice steak thinly against the grain to ensure tender bites.

notes.title: Stove Method
notes.content: Turn on oven broiler to 500F (or high). Heat a large oven safe pan on stove top on high heat or about 5 minutes.
Place steak in hot pan, after 30 seconds flip and sear for another 30 seconds.
Finish in oven: place steak directly under broiler for 3 minutes, flip sear for another 3 minutes.
Remove, rest 5 minutes and serve.

prep.step: Preheat oven to 325F.
In a 4 to 5 quart heavy ovenproof pot heat oil over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Pat meat dry and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Brown meat in hot oil on all sides. Transfer to a plate.
