Add bacon to oil and saute over moderately high heat, stirring frequently, until browned and fat is render, about 3 minutes. Add onion, carrot and celery and saute, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are softened and golden brown. 10 to 12 minutes.
Add garlic, thyme and rosemary and saute, stirring, until garlic begins to soften and turn golden, about 2 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and cook, stirring, 1 minute.
Add wine and boil until liquid is reduced by about half, about 5 minutes. Add water and bring to a simmer, then return meat along with any juices accumulated on the plate to pot.
Cover and transfer to oven. Braise until meat is very tender, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

Transfer to cutting board. Skim fat from surface of sauce and discard herb stems. Boil sauce until reduced by about one third, about 5 minutes, then season with salt. Cut meat across grain in 1/2 inch-thick slices and return to sauce.

ingredients.item: sour cream, to add to soup

prep.step: Cover meat with cold stock or water, add salt, bay leaf and bring to boil.
Skim.
Simmer 30-90 minutes depending on cut of meat.
Add onion, garlic and beets.
Cook 10-15 minutes or until beets almost done.
Add carrot, potato and string beans.
Cook 15 minutes.
Add cabbage.
Cook 10 minutes or until tender.
Stir in tomatoes, reserve juice.
Bring back to temperature.
Combine flour with reserved juice blend well.
Add to pot.
Add lemon juice to desired tartness (1-2 tbsp.).

notes.title: Note
notes.content: Serve HOT. Can top with a dollop of Sour Cream.

prep.step: Prepare Pinto Beans. Pot Method: Put beans into a large pot and cover with at least 3" of water. Bring to boil then lower to a simmer. Simmer, covered, for about 2 1/2 hours or until the beans are tender. Using Canned Beans: Rinse skip to step 2. Pressure Cooker Method: Eight cups of water in pressure cooker, cook on high for 35 to 40 minutes, allow the pressure cooker to cool completely before openning.

In a large skillet, saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent on medium heat. Move to side of pan or, if necessary, remove from skillet and brown the meat. Add chili powder to meat as it is cooking, Start with 1 tablespoon, and add more as needed. Stir in onions and garlic, add cumin and parsley. Add tomatoes and 1 teaspoon of salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 teaspoon of sugar to counteract the acidity of the tomatoes.
Add beans and another teaspoon or more of salt to the beans. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, tasting and adding salt and pepper is needed. Garnish with parsley.
Preheat oven to 400F, pierce potato in several places with a fork, bake until tender, about 1 hour. Let stand until cool.
Peel potato, put in a medium bowl and mash with a fork until smooth.
Add flour, egg, olive oil, lemon zest, salt, pepper and nutmeg and stir just until blended. Turn out the dough on a lightly floured surface, and divide into 8 pieces.
Take 1 piece and roll it between your hands and also on the work surface to a 12-inch long rope. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place gnocchi on lightly floured baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pieces.
To cook, bring large pot to boil with salted water. Add gnocchi and cook until they float. Drain and add any sauce you prefer.

ingredients.item: each celery and carrot, finely chopped

prep.step: In a large, heavy frying pan, combine pork with cold water (or stock) and heat to boiling point. It should be slightly soupy.
Add potato, onion, celery, carrot, and spice mix. Cook, covered over medium-heat for 1 1/4 hours; stir often. Add more water if mixture dries out.
Halfway through cooking time, season with salt to taste.
Stir in rolled oats and cook, stirring for 1 or 2 minutes. Remove bay leaf and allow to cool.
Meanwhile, line two 9-inch pie plates with pastry. When meat mixture is lukewarm, divide it between two pie shells and spread it out evenly.

Brush around outer edge of pastry with the beaten egg. Place top crust on the tart and press gently around the edge to seal. Trim pastry, crimp edges and cut steam vents in top crust. Decorate as desired.
Bake in preheated 425F oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 375F and bake another 25 minutes or until crust is golden.
Makes 2 pies. Use Butter pastry for crust.

Lightly grease and flour a 10-4 inch tube pan. Sift flour with baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside. Wash and pare carrots; grate on medium grater, or use coarse blade of food processor. Should measure 4 cups. Preheat oven to 350F.

In large bowl of mixer, at high speed, beat butter and brown and granulated sugars, occasionally scraping side of bowl with rubber scraper, until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each addition until smooth and light.

In measuring cup, combine lemon and orange rinds and juices. At low speed, beat in flour mixture (in fourths), alternately with lemon-orange mixture (in thirds), beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat just until smooth, about 1 minute.

With wooden spoon, stir in grated carrot, nuts and raisins; mix well. Turn into the prepared tube pan; spread evenly. Bake 60 minutes, or until a cake tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack 20 minutes, to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, make cream-cheese glaze; Lemon-Cream Cheese Icing

Gently loosen edge of cake with a spatula. Turn out of pan onto rack. Spread glaze over top of the warm cake, letting it run down side of cake. Carefully remove cake to cake platter. Sprinkle chopped walnuts around top edge of cake. Serves 12. (Keeps well stored in tightly covered cake tin.)

In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the ground beef and garlic salt and cook until the beef is cooked completely. Drain the grease and set the beef aside.

In the same pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add the tomato paste, vinegar, cumin, chili powder, oregano, seasoned salt, garlic, bell peppers and onion. Cook until softened, 8 to 10 minutes. Add the beef and let them love each other over low heat for 5 more minutes. The mixture should be moist but not dripping wet.

Lightly flour a work surface and roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 4, 5 or 6 inch rounds, depending on how large you prefer. Add some meat filling to each empanada and fold the dough over in half to enclose the filling. Use a fork to press and seal the edges closed. You can refrigerate the uncooked empanadas for up to 3 hours.
IF DEEP FRYING: Heat oil in deep frying to 350F. Fry the empanadas until golden brown, 6 to 7 minutes.
IF BAKING IN OVEN: Place on cookie sheet in 350F oven for approximately 30 to 40 minutes. Check every 15 minutes to ensure they are not overcooked.

notes.title: To make Spice
notes.content: use chipotle sausage and beef

ingredients.item: Parmigano, enough to thoroughly coat the top of the mushrooms
greens for salad base of your choice

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F, Chop up garlic
Cut off any dirty parts of the mushrooms. Remove any stems and hard parts that feel like they'd be gross to eat

Line a baking sheet with some aluminium and drizzle with olive oil. Place mushrooms on tray and drizzle more olive oil, mix in the garlic. Coat with Parmigano, bread crumbs (Panko is better), salt and pepper.
Bake until top is brown and crispy, about 17 to 20 minutes.
Place a portion on each bed of greens. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Add a sprinkle of salted and a vigorous grind of pepper mill to each plate. Serve warm.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: Baked oyster mushrooms, breaded with parmigiano, balsamic vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, and garlics on a bed of greens. An excellent beginning to any menu.

ingredients.name: Beans and Sauce
ingredients.item: fresh green beans,rinsed, trimmed and halved
mushrooms, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch pieces

prep.step: Preheat oven to 475F.

Combine the onions, flour, panko and salt in a large mixing bowl and toss to combine. Coat a sheet pan with non-stick cooking spray and evenly spread the onions on the pan. Place on the middle rack of the oven and bake until golden brown, approximately 30 minutes. Toss the onions 2 or 3 times during cooking. Once done, remove from the oven and set aside until ready to use. Turn oven down to 400F.

While the onions are cooking, prepare th beans. Bring a gallon of water and 2 tbsp. of salt to a boil in a 8 quart saucepan. Add the beans and blanch for 5 minutes. Drain in a colander and immediatelly plunge into a large bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Drain and set aside.

Melt the butter in a 12-inch cast iron skillet set over medium high heat. Add the mushrooms, 1 tsp. of salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms begin to give up some of the their liquid, approximately 4 to 5 minutes. Add the garlic and nutmeg and continue to cook for another 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle the flour over the mixture and stir to combine. Cook to 1 minute. Add the broth and simmer for 1 minute. Decrease the heat to medium low and add the half-and-half. Cook until the mixture thickens, stirring occasionally, approximately 6 to 8 minutes.

Remove from the heat and stir in 1/4 of the onions and all of the green beans. Top with the remaiining onions. Place into the oven and bake until bubbly,approximately 15 minutes. Remove and serve immediately.
Grate the zest from the lemons on the finest side of the grater. Squeeze the juice and strain it into a large measuring cup. You will need 1 1/4 cups lemon juice

Cut the butter into small pieces. Put the pieces into a glass bowl, along with the sugar, lemon zest and juice, set over a pan of gently simmering water. The bottom of the bowl should not touch the water, nor should the water boil rapidly. Stir the mixture until the butter has melted and the sugar has completely dissolved.

Lightly beat the eggs in a bowl, but do not whisk them. Strain the eggs through a fine sieve into the lemon mixture. Simmer over low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the mixture thickens slightly. This will take 20-25 minutes. Do not allow the mixture to boil or it will curdle.
As soon as the mixture is thick enough to coat the back of the spoon, remove the bowl from the pan.
Pour into warmed sterilized jars. Place a waxpaper round, waxed-side down, on top. Smooth over to remove any air pockets. Leave to cool.
Cover with dampened plastic wrap circles. Label and store in the refrigerator. Makes about 3 cups.

ingredients.item: jalapeno or other hot peppers, seeded and finely chopped

prep.step: Preheat oven to 375F. Brush the cups of a standard 12-cup muffin tin with melted butter and set aside. Whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, hot peppers and corn in a large bowl until combined.

With a spatula, fold buttermilk mixture into cornmeal mixture until well combined. Fold in melted butter. Divide batter among muffin cups, filling each three-quarters full. Bake until a cake tester inserted into centre comes out clean, about 25 minutes. Let muffins cool in tin 5 minutes. Turn out into a basket or bowl lined with a clean kitchen towel; cover to keep warm. Serve with butter.
Mix the batter ingredients together

Preheat a pudding tray with 1/2 inch of oil in each section. After 10 minutes divide the batter into the tray. Cook for around 30 minutes until crisp - don't open the oven door before then or they won't rise. Serve with Roast Beef.

ingredients.item: cremini or button mushrooms, cut into quarters

prep.step: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat then add the oil and a single layer of of the chicken thighs. Because you will be adding liquid and lowering the temperature of the chicken, this is the only opportunity you will have to add the rich flavours of caramelized chicken - so be patient. Brown evenly on both sides. When they are done remove and rest on a side plate. Pour off most of the accumulated fat.

Add the onions and mushrooms to the pan. Saute first until they begin to release their juices then as they start to become golden brown. Place the chicken thighs back into the pan; then add the stock, wine, salt and pepper. Bring to a slow simmer; a boil will toughen the meat. Cover the pan with a tight fitting lid so that moisture escapes and simmer slowly until meat is very tender and falling of the bone, about 45 minutes.

ingredients.item: fresh peaches, peeled, pits removed, sliced

prep.step: Combine sliced peaches, brown sugar, tapioca, and lemon juice stirring well to blend. Pour into a buttered 11 x 7 inch baking dish.

Combine the flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon, stirring to blend well. Add the beaten egg, stirring lightly with fork until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle the crumb mixture evenly over the peaches then drizzle with the melted butter. Bake the peach crumble at 375F for 40 to 50 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve warm drizzled with heavy cream, a dollop of whipped cream, or a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

ingredients.item: chopped pecans (1 1/4 cups if making tarts)

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F.

In a saucepan, melt the butter but don't let it brown. Mix in the sugar and corn syrup and cook, stirring over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Stir in eggs. Mix well. Stir in the pecans. Pour into the pie shell and bake for 1 hour or until firm when shaken.

ingredients.item: Each: salt, whole allspice and whole cloves

prep.step: Trim all but 2 inches off beet stems. Cook beets in boiling water, until tender. about 35 to 45 minutes. Remove from water and allow to cool slightly. Skins should now easily slip off beets. Ensure all skin has been completely removed. Cut into large chunks and measure 8 cups. Set aside.
Fill canner with water and bring to a boil. Place 5 clean 500mL mason jars in canner over high heat.
Place lids in boiling water; boil 5 minutes to soften sealing compound.
Combine onions, vinegar, sugar, water, mustard seed, salt, allspice, cloves and cinnamon sticks in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan. Bring to boil; boil gently for 5 minutes.
Add beets and process for 4 to 5 minutes. Remove cinnamon sticks.

Pack beets into a hot jar to within 3/4 inch of top rim. Add boiling liquid to cover beets to within 1/2 inch of top rim (head space). Remove air bubbles by sliding a rubber spatula between glass and food; readjust head space to 1/2 inch. Wipe jar rim removing any stickiness. Center lid on jar; apply screw band just until fingertip tight. Place jar in canner. Repeat for remaining beets and liquid.

Cover canner; return water to boil; process 30 minutes at altitudes up to 1,000 ft. Remove jars. Cool 24 hours. Check jar seals. Sealed lids curve downward. Wipe jars, label and store in a cool dark place.

recipe.title: Roast Beef and Sun Dried Tomato Mayonnaise Panini

prep.step: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, tomatoes, garlic, horseradish, ketchup and cayenne pepper. Mix well.
In a small bowl, toss onion, peppers and pepper flakes together. Drizzle with some of the pickling juice from the peppers. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Spread butter on one side of each bread slice. Spread mayonnaise on the other side. Sprinkle cheese then top with the roast beef. Top roast beef with the pepper salad mixture.
Place other bread slice on top of pepper mixture, buttered side up. Toast on both sides using a heavy skillet on top of sandwich as a weight.
When first side is golden brown, flip, reweight with skillet and finish toasting.

In a small pan, heat milk just until bubbles form around the edges of pan; remove from heat. Add sugar, salt and 1/4 cup butter; stir to melt butter. Cool to lukewarm (drop on wrist to ensure it is not hot). Check temperature of warm water with thermometer.

Sprinkle yeast over water in large bowl; stir to dissolve. Stir in lukewarm milk mixture. Add the egg and 2 cups of the flour; beat with electric mixer until smooth. Add the remaining 1/2 cup flour; mix with hand until dough is smooth and leaves side of bowl

Turn out dough onto lightly floured pasty cloth. Knead until dough is smooth and blisters appear. Place in lightly greased bowl; turn to bring up greased side. Cover with towel; let rise in warm place (30C/85F), free from drafts, until double - 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Meanwhile, make filling: In small bowl, with wooden spoon, cream 1/4 cup butter with 1/4 cup light-brown sugar. Spread on bottom and sides of 9x9x2 inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with pecans.

Roll dough into a 16x12 inch rectangle. Spread with 1/4 cup soft butter; sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar, the raisins and cinnamon. Roll up from long side, jelly-roll fashion; pinch edge to seal. Cut crosswise into 12 pieces; place, cut side down, in pan.

Let rise, covered, in warm place (30C/85F), free from drafts - 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until doubled (rises to top of pan). Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375F. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden. Invert on board; let stand 1 minute; remove pan. Serve warm. Makes 12.
Select meaty pork spareribs that are lean and free of excess fat. For serving as a main dish, you will need about 1 lb. ribs per person.
Place the ribs in a large baking dish. Set ribs aside while your make the marinade. In a small bowl mix ketchup, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, dry sherry and garlic.

Sir the marinade with a spoon until ingredients are thoroughly combined. Spoon over spareribs on both sides, spreading marinade evenly to coat thoroughly. Cover baking dish securely with plastic wrap or tight-fitting lid.

Place baking dish with ribs in the refrigerator to chill overnight. If possible, turn the ribs and brush them with the marinade several times during the refrigeration time. The next day, before serving: Preheat oven to 345F. Remove spareribs from refrigerator.

Uncover baking dish and place on centre rack in preheated oven. Roast for 1 1/2 hours, turning ribs and basting them frequently with the marinade during the roasting time. When done, remove pan from and transfer one rack of ribs to a wooden board.

Using a very sharp knife or cleaver, cut the racks of ribs into serving-size pieces. Repeat with remaining racks. (This much can be done ahead; cover and chill ribs until just before serving. Reheat in preheated oven.) Makes 4 main dish servings or serves 8 or more as hors d'oeuvres.
Preheat oven to 350F.
Melt butter and chocolate together on low heat in a small,heavy pot. Scrape mixture into a large bowl. Stir in egg yolks, sugar,salt and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Stir quarter of egg whites into chocolate mixture then fold in remaining egg whites. Gently fold in flour.

Pour batter into buttered ramekins or 8-inch square baking dish. Place ramekins or baking dish in a large,high-sided baking pan. Carefully pour hotwater into the pan so water comes halfway up the side of ramekins or baking dish.
Bake 25 minutes for ramekins or 35 minutes for 8-inch dish, or until surface is crispy but inside is still gooey and soft. Remove from larger pan to cool.
Whip cream with icing sugar until it forms soft peaks. Serve with mousse.

recipe.title: Sea Salt Caramel Chip Chocolate Cookies

ingredients.item: (10oz.) package Chipits Sea Salt Caramel Chips

prep.step: Preheat oven to 350F. Line cookie sheet with parchment or lightly grease.
Beat butter with brown sugar, sugar and vanilla extract in large bowl until well blended. Add eggs and beat well.
In a separate bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt. Gradually mix into butter mixture, blending well.
Stir in Chipits. Drop rounded 1 teaspoon poritions of cookie dough onto prepared cookie sheet.
Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until cookies are set. Do not over bake. Cold slightly on cookie sheet. Then transfer to wire rack to cool completely. Makes 4 dozen cookies.

ingredients.item: red or yellow or orange bell pepper
pitted kalamata olives (as many as you like)

prep.step: Cook orzo pasta as directed on package. Whilst pasta cooks cut pepper, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes into bite size pieces.
Once the pasta has finish cooking and still slightly warm add it and the vegetables to a large bowl, combine olives and crumble feta cheese over top.

In a separated container mix together the olive oi, balsamic vinegar, Italian spices, mint and as much of the juice from the kalamata olive contain as you like. Shake well to combine then pour over top of vegetable/pasta mixture. Let it sit on counter for a least 1/2 hour to let all the favours combine.
Any leftovers can be stored for a few days in the fridge.

notes.title: Things to consider.
notes.content: This is a guide, feel free to add or subtract any ingredient. The real secret is the juice from the kalamata olives, it really opens the favour of the salad. This is a summer staple in our house. T says enjoy!

ingredients.name: Cake Mix
ingredients.item: fresh or frozen rhubarb, finely diced (2 cups)

prep.step: In a small bowl, combine the white and whole-wheat flours with the baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Set the mixture aside.

In a large bowl, beat the butter or margarine with brown sugar and the white sugar. Add the egg and vanilla, and beat the mixture until it is fluffy. To this mixture alternately add the flour mixture and buttermilk, and beat the ingredients until they are mixed well.
Stir in the rhubarb, and pour the batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan (alternately, fill cup cake molds).
Mix together the topping ingredients, and sprinkle the topping evenly over the batter/cup cakes.
Bake in a preheated 350F oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of cake/cup cake comes out clean.
Preheat ovento 400F.
Ligthly flour work surface and roll the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick. Slice dough into 16 equal strips.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Tie each dough strip into a simple knot, placing each on the baking sheet as you go, spacing them a couple of inches apart. Brush with olive oil.
Combine salt, garlic powder, chili flakes and Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle over knots.
Bake for 15 to 17 minutes, or until lightly browned (watch carefully so they do not burn).

ingredients.name: Filling
ingredients.item: (100 g each) Lindt Excellence Sea Salt Dark Chocolate

prep.step: In a small bowl, dessolve 1 tsp sugar in 1/2 cup warm water. Sprinkle with yeast. Let stand until foamy, 10 minutes. Melt butter and set aside. Meanwhile, in another bowl, whisk milk with egg and vanilla. In a large bowl, whisk flour with 1/2 cup sugar, the cinnamon and salt.

When yeast is foamy, whisk into egg mixture with butter. Stir into flour mixture. Turn onto floured surface. Knead to form a smooth dough, 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl. Turn to coat. Lay damp cloth over bowl. Let rise in a warm place until double, about 2 hours.

Meanwhile, butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. Break chocolate into pieces and place in food processor with the brown sugar. Whirl until finely ground, about 45 seconds. Mixture may have tiny pieces in it. Pour in butter. Pulse until even in texture, about 15 pulses.

When dough has risen, roll in 14 inch square. Evenly cover with chocolate mixture, leaving 1/2 inch border. Firmly press into dough. Starting with side closest to you, roll up dough. Pinch dough to seal seams. Using a serrated knive, trim away uneven ends. Slice roll into 15 buns. Place cut-side down in dish. Lay a damp towel over dish. Let rise 45 minutes.
Bake in 350F oven until buns are golden, 25 to 35 minutes. Let cool 15 minutes. Best served warm

notes.title: Icing Filling
notes.content: Whisk 1 1/2 cups icing sugar with about 2 tbsp. milk, to reach drizzling consistency. Use a fork to drizzle over buns.

prep.step: Mix cheese and mayonnaise until blended, add spices and mix well

notes.title: Substitutions
notes.content: You can replace half (or more) of the mayonnaise with plain yogurt. You can add or subtract the amount of spices as you wish.

prep.step: Set BBQ grill for rotisserie cooking and maintain a temperature of 350F. Set drip tray half filled with water under where the roast will turn. Keep a pitcher of water handy to refresh water as necessary.
Make the salmuera by combining warm water and salt, stir to dissolve.

Thread spit lengthwise through the centre of roast and secure with picks. Mount in rotisserie brackets and turn rotisserie on. Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, brushing with salmuera every 15 to 20 minutes, or until a thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 125F for medium-rare.

Meanwhile, combine all of the smoky chimichurri ingredients (except salt and pepper) in a food processor. Pulse until mixture resembles pesto, scraping down sides as necessary. Season generously with salt and pepper. Turn it out into a small bowl; let stand while roast is cooking.
Carefully transfer roast to a board, tent with foil and let rest for at least 15 minutes. Remove from spit, and cut into thick slices. Serve with chimichurri alongside.
Serves 6 to 10.

recipe.title: Herb and Garlic Pork Loin with Crackling

ingredients.item: skin-on pork loin, with several inches of extra skin if possible

prep.step: Using a sharp knife, score skin about 1/8 inch deep from end to end, perpendicular to the length of the roast. Repeat in 1/4 inch intervals. Be careful to avoid cutting through the skin.

In a small bowl, combine all of the ingredients for the paste, except salt and pepper. Place the roast, skin-side down, on a board; season exposed meat generously with salt and pepper. Spread the paste evenly overtop, avoiding the skin. If excess skin was provided, wrap around meat (it's not necessary to completely enclose). Tie in several places with twine, and set, skin-side up, on a plate. Refridgerate, uncovered, for 4 to 6 hours. Remove from fridge half an hour before cooking.

Set BBQ grill for rotisserie cooking and maintain a temperature of 350F. Set drip tray half filled with water under where the roast will turn. Keep a pitcher of water handy to refresh water as necessary.

Season skin liberally with salt. Thread spit lengthwise through the centre of roast and secure with picks. Mount in rotisserie brackets and turn rotisserie on. Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, depending on thickness, until a thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 140F. Increase the heat to high and maintain a temperature of 550F. Cook 8 to 12 minutes longer or until the skin bubbles and crisps.
Remove to board and let rest, skin-side up, for 15 minutes before carving into slices. Serves 6.

recipe.title: Carrot Cake Muffins with Lemon-Cream Cheese Icing

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, for smearing in muffin cups
applesauce or canned or fresh chopped pineapple
Lemon-Cream Cheese Icing

prep.step: Position your oven racks so that one is in the centre, and preheat the oven to 400F. Smear six big muffin tin cups with butter.
Whisk the flours, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt together in a medium-size bowl.

In a separate, big bowl, whisk the eggs to break up the yolks. Still whisking with one hand, pour in the sugar with the other. Continue whisking for a few minutes, until the eggs begin to pale in colour. Whisk in the oil and applesauce. Stir in the carrots and walnuts.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet, stirring gently with a wooden spoon until there's not a trace of flour visible. This batter will be very runny.
Scoop the batter up with a glass measuring cup or a ladle, and pour it evenly into the six cups of your prepared muffin tin. Wipe off any batter that may have spilled onto the pan.

Place the muffin tin on the centre rack in the oven, and bake the muffins for 35 - 40 minutes, until they begin to darken and a toothpick or small knife inserted deep into the centre of a muffin comes out clean.

Remove the tin from the oven, and place it on a wire rack. Let muffins sit for a few minutes in the tin, until they're cool enough to touch. To remove the muffins, flip the tin upside down and let the muffins fall out onto the wire rack to cool completely.
Just before you're ready to serve these, spread a nice thick layer of lemon-cream cheese icing on top with a rubber or offset spatula.
Beat the butter and cream cheese together in a big bowl, using the whisk attachment on an electric mixer on high speed until they're smooth and creamy and totally combined.

Gradually sift the sugar over the bowl beating all the while, until there are no lumps left. Add the remaining ingredients and beat until the icing is smooth. If you find that while you were making icing thin, you may want to put the icing in the refrigerator before using it.

ingredients.item: large Plum or Roma tomato, deseeded and diced

prep.step: Add minced onion to a small bowl the cover with warm water, set aside. This "deflames" the onions, making them less intense.
Cut avocados in half, remove seed and scoop out the flesh into a bowl.
Add lime juice then, using a fork, gently mash until creamy, but still a little chunky. Stir in the tomato, herbs, cumin, onions and salt. Taste and adjust with additiona salt or lime juice.
Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap by pushing the wrap down onto the guacamole and refridgerate up to one day.

notes.title: Additional Stuff
notes.content: To add a little heat add 1 to 2 teaspoons of minced jalapeno or Serrano pepper.

recipe.title: Gnocchi with Mushrooms and Gorgonzola Sauce

prep.step: Lightly brush a rimmed baking sheet with oil; set aside. Bring a large pot of water to boil; add the salt. Add gnocchi; when they rise to the top, continue to tender, about 15 seconds more. Transfer with a slotted spoon to baking sheet.

Bring cream and stock to a boil in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Reduce heat and let mixture simmer until slightly thickened and reduced by one-third. Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir in nutmeg and pepper. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat; cover to keep warm.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and any released liquid has evaporated. Add gnocchi; cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through and slightly browned. Pour sauce over gnocchi; gently toss. Serve.

ingredients.item: chopped fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried basil

prep.step: In a small bowl combine butter, blue cheese, parsley, basil and garlic, set aside.
Grill steak to desired doneness. Top each steak with generous amounts of butter mixture.
Chill remaining butter for another time. Try mixture tossed on hot mixed vegetables.

ingredients.item: (4 lb.) brisket, deckle on if you prefer

prep.step: Preheat oven to 320F.
Combine mustard, soy sauce and thyme in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Brush paste over brisket.
Add 2 tbsp. of oil to a Dutch Oven, and brown brisket on both sides, then remove and set aside on a plate.
Add carrots and onions and saute for a minute or so. Add brisket, stock and tomatoes. Stir in vinegar and chili flakes.
Cover and place in oven for 5 to 6 hours. Check every hour or so, rotating the brisket, cook until fork tender.
Place cooked brisket on a cutting board, remove garlic pieces from sauce, and serve brisket over the cooked vegetables.

ingredients.item: cider vinegar (to add to sauce when reducing)

ingredients.name: Spice Rub
ingredients.item: cayenne pepper depending upon your taste

prep.step: Pre-heat oven to 320F.
Rub spice mixture all over the beef. Heat a glug of oil in a large fry pan and brown the beef on both sides. Transfer to a large baking tray.

Add a bit more oil to the fry pan if necessary and cook onions, garlic and brown sugar together until caramelised. Add tomato paste and bay leaves and cook for another minute. Then add beer and beef stock and bring to boil. Transfer the mixture to the tray with the beef.
Cover tightly with foil and cook for 6 - 8 hours. Check on the beef every hour or so and turn in liquid. Cook until beef falls apart with a fork.
When finished, remove beef set aside. Pour liquid to saucepan and bring to boil add cider (to taste), simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until reduced. Pour over the shredded beef and serve.
Whisk buckwheat flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt together in a bowl.

Beat buttermilk, egg and vanilla together in another bowl. Pour flour mixture into buttermilk mixture; whisk until batter is thick and smooth. Let batter rest or 5 minutes until bubbles form and batter relaxes.

Melt butter on a griddle over middle heat. Drop batter by large spoonfuls onto the griddle and cook until bubbles form and the edges are dry, 3 to 4 minutes. Flip can cook until browned on the other side, 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.
